At Fife Council, planning is about more than determining applications. We are helping to create sustainable places, support economic growth, tackle climate change and improve the quality of life for our communities.


By joining our team you'll benefit from:


* Working on a wide variety of planning projects and developments across urban, rural and coastal communities.
* Opportunities to gain experience across Development Management, Planning Policy and wider place\-based initiatives.
* A supportive and collaborative team environment.
* Flexible and blended working arrangements.
* Excellent training and professional development opportunities.
* Support towards RTPI career progression and continuing professional development.
**The Person**

We are looking for enthusiastic, motivated and customer\-focused individuals who are passionate about planning and making a positive difference to places and communities.


You will bring strong communication, analytical and problem\-solving skills, alongside the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues, communities, developers and other stakeholders.


Applications are welcomed from graduates, early\-career planners and experienced planning professionals. We are interested in candidates who can demonstrate planning knowledge and experience appropriate to the level of post they are applying for.


You will hold a degree or equivalent qualification in Town and Country Planning or a related discipline recognised by the RTPI.


For Chartered Planner posts, candidates must hold Chartered Membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute and maintain this throughout their employment.


Please clearly indicate within your supporting statement which post or post you are applying for and, where applicable, your RTPI membership status.

jobs.title: Graduate Town Planner
jobs.description:
Are you looking to start or develop your career in Town Planning and help shape the future of Coventry?


We have an exciting opportunity for a Graduate Town Planner to join Coventry City Council’s Planning Service.


Coventry is a diverse, growing and ambitious city, and this role provides an excellent opportunity to develop your professional planning career while contributing to the sustainable growth, development and regeneration of the city.

**What is the role?**


As a Graduate Town Planner, you will provide an efficient, effective and customer\-focused professional planning service, supporting the sustainable growth and regeneration of Coventry.


A key focus of the role is your professional development. You will have the opportunity to gain broad experience across the Planning Service, spending time working within areas including:

* Development Management – supporting the processing of planning applications, lawful development certificates, prior approvals and pre\-application enquiries.
* Planning Policy – supporting research and contributing to the Local Plan and other planning policy documents.
* Urban Design and Heritage – gaining experience in how good design, heritage and the historic environment influence the development of the city.
* Planning monitoring and delivery – supporting monitoring, performance information and other areas of the wider planning function.


These opportunities reflect the breadth of experience contained within the Graduate Town Planner role.


You will work alongside experienced planning professionals, developing your technical knowledge and practical skills while gaining an understanding of how planning decisions and policies shape Coventry's communities, neighbourhoods and future development.

**Your professional development**


We want this role to provide you with a strong foundation for a successful career in planning.


Ideally, you will continue your professional development through further learning, with support to work towards a Master's degree in Planning and ultimately Chartered Town Planner status.


You will have opportunities to develop your experience across different areas of the service, build your professional planning knowledge and gain practical experience of working within a busy local authority Planning Service.

**Who are we looking for?**


Do you hold a degree or equivalent qualification in Town Planning or a related discipline, which would enable you to continue your professional development as part of a Master's degree in Planning?


Alternatively, do you have experience of working within a Planning Team and want to formally pursue a graduate\-level planning qualification?


If so, we would love to hear from you.


We are looking for someone who:

* Has a genuine interest in Town Planning and the development of places and communities.
* Is enthusiastic about developing a professional career in planning.
* Has good written, verbal and face\-to\-face communication skills.
* Can interpret plans, maps and drawings and has good attention to detail.
* Can organise and prioritise their workload and work to deadlines.
* Is confident using IT and digital systems.
* Can work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
* Has a positive, flexible and customer\-focused approach.
* Is willing to learn, develop and undertake further professional training.


These requirements align with the existing Grade 4 person specification, which emphasises an interest in Town Planning, communication, mapping and drawing appreciation, IT capability, customer care, prioritisation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

**What you'll get from us**


This is more than an opportunity to secure your first professional planning role. It is an opportunity to build your planning career within one of the UK's most diverse and ambitious cities.


You'll gain practical experience across different planning disciplines, work alongside experienced professionals and have the opportunity to contribute to real projects and decisions that influence Coventry's future.


If you are enthusiastic, keen to learn and want to develop into a professional Town Planner, we'd love to receive your application.

**Right to Work**


All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK. We are currently not offering sponsorship for this role.

**What we offer?**


At Coventry City Council, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, development, and work\-life balance:

* **Competitive salary** with incremental progression and salary matching
* **Generous annual leave starting at 28 days annual leave** (plus Bank Holidays) with option to purchase more and rising to 33 days following 5 years service.
* **Generous local government pension scheme** to help plan for your future
* **Lifestyle discounts** across a wide range of activities and retailers
* **Flexible working arrangements** to support your personal and professional needs
* **Inclusive Employee Networks**: EmbRace, Pride, Disability, Young people, and Women
* **Employee Assistance Programme** offering confidential support
* **Certified training courses** to help you grow and thrive


Explore the full range of benefits at \#MyRewards – Coventry City Council


All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK. We are currently not offering sponsorship for this role.


If you need help or support to complete your application, please visit our accessibility page to see how we can assist you.


Guaranteed Interview Scheme \- As part of our commitment to inclusion, we offer guaranteed interviews for specific groups of people. To qualify, you'll need to meet the minimum requirements for the role and identify with one of the below criteria:

* Members of the Armed Forces and veterans
* Are currently in care or have previously been in care
* If you consider yourself to be disabled or if you have a long\-term health condition

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Integrated Business Planning Analyst**

**Location:** Remote  

**Department:** Integrated Business Planning  

**Reports To:** Sr. Manager, Demand Planning

**Job Summary**


The **Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Analyst** plays a critical role in balancing supply and demand across regions, channels, and product lines. This position owns the global inventory allocation framework, monitors and drives global demand planning attainment, and is the custodian of IBP process excellence. You will partner cross\-functionally with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Logistics, Commercial, and Finance to enable customer service performance while optimizing working capital and other financial objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Inventory Allocation**

* Design, maintain, and continuously improve the global inventory allocation strategy, including prioritization rules for regions/channels/customers and ATP/CTP guardrails.
* Run allocation cycles and exception management: reconcile planned supply vs. demand, apply fair\-share logic, and resolve escalations.
* Configure and steward allocation and inventory policies (e.g., service class/service level, safety stock settings, MOQ, lead times, and EOQ) and ensure alignment to business rules.
* Monitor inventory health (DOH, turns, excess/obsolete, stranded stock) and lead corrective action plans (rebalancing, substitutions, transfers).
* Drive root cause analysis on stockouts and late orders; publish action plans with owners and deadlines.
* Own back order reporting and supply risk communication with Business Unit.

**Demand Planning Attainment \& Forecast Quality**

* Track and report monthly demand planning attainment for global regions against IBP baselines; establish clear definitions for attainment and bias.
* Build and maintain forecast accuracy (MAPE, WAPE) and bias dashboards by region, product family, lifecycle stage, and customer segment.
* Diagnose drivers of variation (promotions, NPI, cannibalization, price changes, seasonality) and recommend model or parameter adjustments.
* Partner with Demand Planners and Sales to improve signal quality and enhance consensus inputs.

**S\&OP Process Management**


Support execution of calendar, inputs, and outputs for IBP cycle (Demand Review Supply Review Pre\-S\&OP* Executive S\&OP).
* Standardize and document process artifacts (templates, SOPs, RACI, data definitions, exception codes and other policies).
* Facilitate cross\-functional alignment on constrained/unconstrained plans, trade\-offs, and executive decisions; ensure decisions are logged and tracked to closure.
* Drive continuous improvement (lean, digital, automation) to reduce cycle time, manual work, and improve decision quality.
* Partner with Center of Excellence to implement key strategic initiatives.

**Analytics \& Decision Support**

* Build and automate reports: inventory allocation effectiveness, demand attainment, service level, fill rate, backlog age, expedites, cost\-to\-serve.
* Develop scenario analyses (what\-if/what\-then) for constraint management, allocation policy changes, and demand surges.
* Provide ad hoc analysis to support commercial priorities, NPI ramps, inventory projections, end\-of\-life strategies, channel/customer special programs, and supply disruptions.
* Translate insights into clear recommendations with quantified impact (service, revenue, margin, cash).
* Ensure master data integrity (SKU, BOM, lead times, horizons, MOQ, pack sizes, ABC classification).
* Maintain KPIs, thresholds, and alerting (e.g., allocation SLA, forecast bias guardrails, inventory age bands).
* Own back order projection for the Business Unit for both manufacturing and commercial back order.

**Communication \& Collaboration**

* Act as a liaison between commercial teams, supply planning, quality, and logistics teams to ensure alignment and resolve conflicts.
* Support IBP meetings with accurate updates and insights.
* Escalate potential risks to supply and demand plans and propose mitigation plans.
* Participate in the daily S\&OE and weekly meetings with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, and Materials; surface risks, make trade\-offs, and drive decisions.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 3–5\+ years in S\&OP, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, or Inventory Management in a multi\-region environment.

**Preferred**

* Proficiency with planning systems (e.g., SAP IBP, Oracle, Kinaxis RapidResponse, o9, Anaplan; or equivalent), and advanced Excel/Power BI/Tableau.
* Strong analytical capabilities (SQL, Power Query, or Python a plus); experience building dashboards and automating reports.
* Demonstrated ability to run cross\-functional processes, manage escalations, and present to senior stakeholders.
* Knowledge of inventory optimization concepts (service levels, safety stock, EOQ, ABC/XYZ) and forecast quality metrics (MAPE, WAPE, Bias).
* Experience with global product portfolios, multi\-plant/multi\-DC networks, and channel/customer allocation.
* Familiarity with constraint\-based planning, ATP/CTP, and fair\-share allocation logic.
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Exposure to demand sensing, POS integration, and lifecycle/NPI forecasting.

**Core Competencies**

* Systems Thinking: Connects demand, supply, and inventory policies to end\-to\-end outcomes.
* Analytical Capability: Able to utilize Excel, PowerBI, AI and other data to support complex analysis.
* Data\-Driven: Comfortable with complex, noisy data; builds reproducible analytics.
* Process Excellence: Designs clear workflows and improves them over time.
* Influence \& Communication: Simplifies trade\-offs and analysis, aligns stakeholders, and drives decisions.
* Bias for Action: Prioritizes customer outcomes while protecting working capital.
* Detail Orientation: High standards for data quality, documentation, and auditability.

jobs.title: Senior GIS Analyst
GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
**Clay County \- Small Towns. Big Passions.**


Pay:


$30\.69 \- $35\.90**Job Summary**


Performs professional and technical geographic information systems (GIS) work in support of the County's Stormwater Utility and Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4\) program. Responsibilities include stewarding stormwater infrastructure and outfall data; incorporating new\-development assets from as\-built records; supporting impervious\-area, parcel, subdivision, and condominium analysis; integrating inspection, compliance, maintenance, and information from the County's asset and work management system; and producing maps, dashboards, reports, and data products for program operations and decision\-making.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

The following essential job functions are not intended to serve as a comprehensive list of all duties performed, only a representative summary of the primary duties and responsibilities. The Analyst may be required to perform additional, position\-specific duties.

* Serves as GIS data steward for the Stormwater Utility/MS4 program and maintains authoritative stormwater datasets within the County Enterprise GIS.
* Develops, maintains, and documents geodatabase feature classes, attributes, relationships, domains, metadata, and editing procedures for stormwater infrastructure and related program data.
* Maintains and improves the inventory of stormwater conveyances, inlets and catch basins, culverts, pipes, ditches and swales, retention and detention facilities, structural controls, and other assigned assets.
* Reviews as\-built plans and related development records and creates or updates GIS features and attributes for newly constructed pipes, ponds, inlets, and other stormwater infrastructure.
* Develops and maintains the MS4 outfall inventory and map, including unique identification, location, receiving\-water information, status, and links to supporting inspection records and photographs.
* Researches and compiles information from as\-built plans, plats, surveys, aerial imagery, permits, field observations, and other County records to create or update stormwater features and attributes.
* Plans and performs data collection and verification using GIS tools; coordinates access and verification needs with stormwater staff and field crews.
* Enters, updates, reconciles, and supports the exchange of assigned stormwater asset information between Enterprise GIS and the County's asset and work management system in accordance with approved data ownership and workflow procedures.
* Configures and supports mobile maps, forms, and data\-collection workflows used by program staff and inspectors, and integrates submitted inspection and compliance data with Enterprise GIS.
* Performs spatial and tabular quality\-control reviews to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, inaccurate, or unsupported stormwater records and coordinates correction with the responsible data owner.
* Maintains data documentation and an auditable history of source records, edits, verification status, and quality\-control actions for material stormwater datasets.
* Performs parcel, land\-use, service\-area, and impervious\-area analysis needed to develop, validate, and maintain the technical GIS inputs supporting the stormwater assessment methodology.
* Creates and maintains subdivision, condominium, common\-area, community development district (CDD), and homeowners association (HOA) boundary information needed for stormwater mapping and assessment support.
* Calculates and documents total impervious area, common\-area impervious area, and lot counts within subdivisions and condominiums and prepares GIS\-derived inputs used to allocate a proportional share of common\-area impervious surface among benefited lots in accordance with the adopted assessment methodology.
* Associates available CDD or HOA water\-management permits and responsibility information with the applicable mapped areas and maintains links to supporting source records.
* Coordinates with internal County departments to reconcile GIS\-derived parcel and impervious\-area information with assessment records.
* Integrates stormwater asset, inspection, illicit\-discharge, maintenance, and project information as approved so program staff can locate records and evaluate history by asset or geography.
* Develops maps, web maps, dashboards, reports, and other graphical and non\-graphical products for MS4 reporting, program management, maintenance planning, public information, presentations, and leadership review.
* Supports data requests and recurring reporting by preparing defensible GIS statistics, maps, and extracts and by documenting methods, limitations, and source dates.
* Coordinates with internal County Departments, stormwater inspectors, consultants, and other data owners to define and maintain data standards and workflows.
* Provides technical assistance and to authorized County staff in the use of stormwater GIS applications, mobile workflows, maps, dashboards, and data standards.
* Develops and maintains procedures, data dictionaries, workflow documentation, cross\-training materials, and continuity resources that support knowledge transfer and succession planning for stormwater GIS functions.
* Assists with emergency response and recovery mapping, and damage\-information support as assigned before, during, and after hazardous weather or a state of local emergency.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Geomatics, Environmental Science, Planning, Civil Engineering Technology, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
* Two years of progressively responsible professional experience using GIS for data development, geodatabase maintenance, spatial analysis, quality control, web mapping, or mobile workflows.
* Experience with Esri ArcGIS applications and enterprise geodatabases.

jobs.description:
At Aristocrat, we proudly lead the global gaming content and technology market with a mission to bring happiness through play. As a Cyber Compliance Analyst, you will join our Governance, Risk, and Compliance team in the Global Information Security group. This excellent role lets you significantly influence our cybersecurity objectives. You will collaborate closely with various teams across the company and engage with external customers, suppliers, and partners. This role carries the responsibility of supporting a security policy program and managing its related exceptions process. You will be instrumental in promoting a security-first culture within our organization. Using innovative tools and technologies, you will help safeguard our global operations. Join us on this exciting journey where your contributions truly matter!

What You'll Do

Lead and contribute to cyber compliance activities across global audits, help with evidence collection, improve processes, and mentor less experienced team members.
Assist in handling SOC1, SOC2, and Multi-State Lottery (MUSL) audits throughout North and Latin America. Assist the broader compliance group with ISO 27001, IT General Controls, Gaming Labs International (GLI), and PCI audits.
Support multi-functional work within the GRC team including support of third-party assessments and cybersecurity policy creation and updates.
Partner with the internal audit team, assisting in cyber responses to findings and driving remediation efforts.
Work with collaborators across the business to identify, track, and resolve risks through structured risk management processes.
Support the broader information security program, aligning with Aristocrat’s strategy, including critical metrics.
Spot opportunities to strengthen cybersecurity, proactively identify gaps and recommend improvements.
Help build and advance our global cybersecurity strategy and support the execution of key security initiatives.

What We're Looking For

Required

2+ years of proven track record in information security audit/compliance field
Practical experience participating in and leading SOC 1, SOC 2, MUSL audits, along with familiarity with ISO 27001 and PCI DSS certifications.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with frameworks like NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, and experience with gaming industry standards (e.g., GLI-GSF, GLI-19, GLI-33) or U.S. gaming regulations (e.g., MUSL).
Experience with AI and automation technologies to support increased automation of GRC processes.
A proactive, adaptable mindset—you’re comfortable navigating an evolving cybersecurity landscape.
Teamwork skills and a team-first demeanor in a global environment.
Sharp analytical and critical thinking abilities along with clear and confident written and verbal communication capabilities.

Preferred Certifications

CISA, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, and/or CompTIA Security+

This is a great chance to create a real impact on global cybersecurity efforts. You will work with a diverse group of partners and help define how security and compliance develop at Aristocrat. You’ll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team where your ideas and expertise truly matter!

Why Aristocrat?

Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top-tier publisher of free-to-play mobile games. We deliver great performance for our B2B customers and bring joy to the lives of the millions of people who love to play our casino and mobile games. And while we focus on fun, we never forget our responsibilities. We strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay, and to lift the bar in company governance, employee wellbeing and sustainability. We’re a diverse business united by shared values and an inspiring mission to bring joy to life through the power of play.

We aim to create an environment where individual differences are valued, and all employees have the opportunity to realize their potential. We welcome and encourage applications from all people regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, cultural background, disability status or LGBTQ+ identity. EEO M/F/D/V

World Leader in Gaming Entertainment
Robust benefits package
Global career opportunities

Our Values

All about the Player
Talent Unleashed
Collective Brilliance
Good Business Good Citizen

Travel Expectations

Up to 25%

Pay Range

$104,951 - $175,500 per year

Our goal is to pay a market competitive salary focusing near the median of our pay ranges. However, final offers for all positions will be based on several factors such as experience level, education, skills, work location, and internal pay equity.

This position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan with employer matching, more details available at https://atibenefits.com/.

Additional Information

This role is subject to mandatory background screening and regulatory approvals. As part of your employment with Aristocrat, you may be required to complete a criminal background check, submit fingerprints, and obtain licenses or registrations with applicable gaming regulatory authorities.

Aristocrat operates in a highly regulated environment and holds licenses in over 340 gaming jurisdictions worldwide. To meet our global compliance obligations, you will be required to provide the disclosure of relevant personal and background information to government agencies, sovereign nations/tribal regulators, and other applicable gaming regulatory bodies. This is a condition of Aristocrat’s gaming licenses. The specific information required may vary depending on the jurisdiction and project assignment.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location for this position on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Analyst (MS), AML (Anti-Money Laundering)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

The AML/KYC Senior Analyst supports the day-to-day execution of the investor onboarding and lifecycle due diligence. This role is focused specifically on private fund investor KYC, including intake, documentation review, entity verification, screening, and file completion, day-to-day production activities supporting investor onboarding and lifecycle monitoring. This role executes defined procedures while developing deeper AML/KYC expertise and supporting SLA‑driven workstreams. Senior Analysts execute defined onboarding procedures across a range of investor types, ensuring subscription-related due diligence files are complete, accurate, and compliant with applicable AML requirements and internal standards.

This role is production-oriented and SLA-driven, with responsibility for identifying documentation gaps, escalating risk triggers, and maintaining high-quality case documentation across onboarding volumes.

What you’ll do:

Perform investor intake, document collection, review, and verification.
Execute AML/KYC tasks in accordance with SOPs.
Handle lower-complexity onboarding or lifecycle cases.
Clearly document findings and decisions.
Escalate issues or data gaps following defined guidelines.
Meet productivity, quality, SLA, and turnaround time targets.

To Qualify for the role, you will have:

2–4 years of AML/KYC, compliance, or financial services experience.
Prior experience supporting onboarding and due diligence workflows.
Familiar with institutional investor documentation and entity structures.
Strong attention to detail, file organization discipline, and ability to work in SLA-driven environments.
Willingness to learn and expand AML/KYC expertise.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Major or concentration in compliance, criminal justice, law, business, accounting, finance, and/or economics preferred.

Skills and Attributes for Success:

Demonstrated professional integrity
Dependable, flexible, and adaptable to new ACA initiatives and changing client needs
Ability to exercise discretion and make independent judgments on matters of significance
Ability to work in a fast-paced, small team environment
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and clients
Highly motivated and goal oriented; pro-active in one’s own education and career progression; volunteers for and shows initiative on both internal and external projects and tasks
Dedicated to upholding ACA’s high-quality standards and customer service focus
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Strong oral and written communication skills
Proficient with Microsoft Office applications and comfortable working in a tech enabled environment.

What working at ACA offers:

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. We also offer unique benefits such as Student Debt Forgiveness and Pet Insurance.

About ACA:

ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. Our innovative approach integrates consulting, managed services, and our ComplianceAlpha® technology platform with the specialized expertise of former regulators and practitioners and our deep understanding of the global regulatory landscape.

What we commit to:

ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Salary Range: $65,000.00

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - Mid-Market / Enterprise
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

This role is a key driver of growth and success across a book of business. This portfolio includes customers with complex, technical workflows, where a strategic and consultative approach is essential to maximize value. The individual will work closely with Account Managers, Implementation Engineers, Technical Account Managers, and the Product team to ensure customers are fully supported and empowered to succeed.

At the heart of this work is building strong, strategic relationships—deeply understanding each customer’s business goals and aligning them with the organization’s capabilities to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain strong business relationships and regular, strategic touchpoints with the assigned book of business
Guide customers through onboarding and adoption with a consultative lens, often including paid services and workflow design
Own premium onboarding cases by assisting customers in the template and workflow set up, leading training sessions and driving value within their first 90 days
Drive product adoption and usage through proactive engagement and tailored Success Plans, focusing on long-term customer outcomes
Identify and mitigate risk by uncovering usage blockers and developing customer-centric solutions to reduce churn and contraction
Analyze account metrics (e.g., license usage, document activity, engagement trends) to create success benchmarks and guide business reviews
Own customer escalations when they arise—working cross-functionally to drive swift resolution—while proactively addressing early signals to prevent issues from escalating
Partner closely with Account Managers to align on renewal strategy, inform upsell paths, and support expansion opportunities
Collaborate with Solutions Engineers and Technical Account Managers to address complex workflow requirements and technical use cases
Proactively engage with the Product and Support teams to advocate for customer feedback and ensure it’s routed through the right channels
Monitor tools to surface actionable insights and provide targeted outreach to accounts needing additional support
Serve as a thought partner to both customers and teammates—sharing insights, elevating questions, and championing collaboration across teams
Leverage AI-powered tools to analyze customer usage data, forecast risks, and identify revenue expansion opportunities
Quickly synthesize call insights, product adoption patterns, and stakeholder sentiment using AI assistants to stay proactive
Partner with the team and Operations to improve AI workflows and continuously refine customer playbooks

This is a role for someone who thrives in a strategic, customer-facing environment, is energized by solving complex challenges, and is passionate about delivering long-term customer value through deep partnership and cross-functional collaboration.

Why the Role is Exciting

Joining this organization means being part of an innovative company that is changing how businesses handle their document workflows. There is an opportunity to make a measurable impact by helping clients unlock productivity gains, streamline processes, and achieve their business goals. As part of the Customer Success team, the individual will be at the forefront of client satisfaction, directly contributing to the organization's continued growth and success. If you thrive in an ever-evolving environment and love the challenge of making customers successful, this is the role for you!

About You

Experienced & Strategic:
Bring 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management within a SaaS environment, ideally working with mid-market, upmarket or enterprise-level customers. A proven track record of driving adoption, retention, and long-term value through strategic relationships—especially at the executive level.

Executive Presence & Communication:
A confident communicator, skilled at engaging with C-level stakeholders and navigating complex organizational structures. Ability to clearly and effectively communicate value across multiple channels and functions, ensuring alignment at all levels of the customer's organization.

Customer-Centric & Relationship-Driven:
Understand the importance of building deep, trusted partnerships. Empathetic, a strong listener, and takes a consultative approach to customer relationships—ensuring both tactical needs and long-term strategic goals are met.

Organized & Detail-Oriented:
Highly organized and excels at managing competing priorities. Delivers high-quality service with precision, even in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

Strategic Thinker & Problem Solver:
Thrives on solving complex challenges. Thinks big-picture, anticipates customer needs, and proactively identifies opportunities to deliver value. Knows how to align the platform’s capabilities with the customer’s business goals.

Growth-Oriented & Accountable:
Self-motivated, coachable, and always looking for ways to grow. Takes full ownership of work and consistently follows through on commitments.

Agile & Collaborative:
Adapts quickly to change and loves working cross-functionally to ensure the best outcomes for customers. Brings energy to the team and fosters a collaborative, supportive environment where others can succeed.

AI:
Comfortably learns, experiments with, and drives adoption of new AI features as part of an evolving CS tech stack.

Company Overview

This organization empowers more than 60,000 growing organizations to thrive by taking the work out of document workflow. The platform provides an all-in-one document workflow automation solution that helps fast-scaling teams accelerate the ability to create, manage, and sign digital documents including proposals, quotes, contracts, and more.

Company Culture

The team is known for its work-life balance, kind co-workers, & virtual team bonding events. Although team members are located remotely across the globe, they stay connected with the help of technology and ensure that everyone on the team feels like a team.

Team members work best when they're happy. Talent is retained by upholding values of integrity & transparency, and selling a product that changes the lives of customers.

Benefits

Employees may be able to purchase company stock (or receive annual bonuses). Employees (and their families) may enroll in the company's medical, dental, vision, short & long term disability, life insurance, FSA and 401k plans. Employees will also receive 13.34+ hours of paid time off per month, 6 self-care days, a birthday PTO day, and 10 company-paid holidays off per year.

The annual OTE is up $100,000
(base + bonus combined).

The hiring company is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
Esper was founded in 2018 with the mission to empower dynamic and responsive policymaking in government. Esper’s goal is to align existing data, stakeholders and public policy goals to streamline the policymaking process at all levels of Government. We imagine a world where policymaking is driven by data and insights from all stakeholders, and we are transforming traditional bureaucracy into a dynamic and flexible system that encourages innovation and collaboration.

Job Description:

Esper is looking for an experienced Customer Success Lead to serve as a long-term partner to our customers. The customer journey doesn’t stop at launch. Our goal is durable adoption, measurable outcomes, and partnerships that grow over time.

As the Customer Success Lead, you’ll lead Esper’s next-stage CS evolution: moving from effective generalist motions to a specialized, scalable organization with clear ownership, consistent customer experiences, and predictable retention outcomes. You’ll be accountable for our retention and renewal performance, strengthening adoption and customer health, and building the operating system (people, process, and tooling) that supports growth.

You’ll thrive here if you’re resourceful, decisive, highly organized, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with a strong bias for execution and continuous feedback.

As a bonus, we’d love it if you have a strong interest in policymaking and government! We believe policy shapes our daily lives more than most realize, and central to the role is helping us build software for transforming how policy is created through better data and transparency.

What you'll do:

Become an “Espert” and trusted advisor by building a deep understanding of Esper’s product, our customers, and their goals
Lead and scale Esper’s Customer Success function, including specialization, role clarity, and operating rhythms
Own renewals end-to-end across our U.S. customer base, including renewal strategy, pricing/terms, negotiation, and close
Drive adoption and outcomes post-launch through onboarding reinforcement, enablement, success plans, and ongoing check-ins
Build strong relationships with government employees at multiple levels of seniority through regular meetings, proactive outreach, and in-person engagement
Identify and lead expansion opportunities (upsell/cross-sell) in partnership with the Professional Services, Sales, and Executive teams
Establish and iterate CS playbooks (onboarding reinforcement, stakeholder changes, at-risk recovery, renewal prep, customer advocacy motion, EBRs/QBRs)
Improve customer customer-facing collateral (help center articles, user guides, in-product comms, release comms)
Manage customer support coverage and ensure issues are prioritized, communicated, and resolved with urgency
Serve as the internal voice of the customer, partnering cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to translate feedback into improvements
Report on customer health, adoption, renewal status, and key risks/opportunities for leadership

Success in this role looks like

Renewals are predictable and strong: accurate forecasting, proactive risk management, and consistently high retention (>95%)
CS roles are specialized with crisp handoffs; customers experience “one Esper” despite internal specialization
Measurable increases in adoption and time-to-value across the customer base
Trusted customer champions and referenceable accounts
Repeatable CS processes, playbooks, and a foundation that can scale

What we're looking for:

6+ years in Customer Success or Account Management with at least 2 years managing/leading programs through scale and specialization
Track record of owning retention outcomes and leading complex renewals with senior stakeholders
Strong analytical and operational chops, can build process and run it
Excellent written and verbal communication (recaps, success plans, exec updates)
Comfort working cross-functionally with Product/Engineering on feedback and fixes
Bias for action and focus on customer outcomes
Team player with a “whatever it takes” mentality
Bonus: public sector or govtech experience
Ability to travel domestically (up to 30%) depending on business need

Perks and Benefits:

Being a part of an innovative and collaborative team that will both support and challenge you
Significant opportunity for growth and ownership and to shape Esper for the long-term
Competitive salary and equity at a growing early-stage company
Paid holidays & unlimited PTO
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Generous parental & sick leave
401(k) retirement plan with employer match
Short/Long term disability & life insurance
Flexible spending account (FSA)
Work anniversary equity grants
Monthly stipend to offset remote work expenses
Office equipment allowance
Paid Time Off to participate in volunteer/community events

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Governance, Risk and Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Joining Arup

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 75 years, guiding how we shape a better world.

Digital Technology’s Cyber GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) team is responsible for ensuring that Arup’s cybersecurity practices align with internal policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. The team manages cyber risks by developing governance frameworks, assessing threats, implementing controls, monitoring compliance, and supporting audits. Our goal is to reduce security risks while enabling business objectives in a secure and compliant manner

The Opportunity

At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

Develop, maintain, and test the organisation’s IT Disaster Recovery (ITDR) plans
Conduct regular risk assessments and impact analyses to identify critical systems, dependencies, and recovery priorities.
Manage global cybersecurity awareness campaigns and training initiatives to strengthen security culture.
Collaborate with regional digital teams to embed security-by-design principles into projects and products.
Drive implementation and ongoing compliance with ISO 22301 standards, ensuring the organisation meets global BCM requirements.

Did you know:
Our Digital Technology team are proud prior winners of the IT Team of the Year at the Chartered Institute of IT’s UK IT Industry Awards.

Is this role right for you?

Demonstrate strong skills in IT DR and ISO22301 compliance within a global digital technology environment.
Have a solid understanding of assessing and enhancing BIA, application dependencies, and engaging key stakeholders in IT DR activities.
Bring experience in threat and risk assessment.
Show enthusiasm for cyber awareness and education, with a desire to lead global initiatives that encourage cultural change.
Value ongoing learning and is motivated to develop further in a supportive, international, and innovative organisation.

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Please email Kat.Falepau@arup.com

What We Offer You

At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.

Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.

We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.

We care about you and want you to perform at your best, which is why we offer one of the most competitive benefits packages in our sector.

As a member organisation, everyone shares in our success through a global profit share scheme (payments are dependent on the firm’s financial performance).

We also provide private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. Works under the general direction of the OEM (Office of Emergency Management) Manager to develop, coordinate, and oversee emergency/disaster plans for City of Memphis. Works with other agencies of the National Incident Management System (NIMS) to manage incidents involving all threats and hazards to reduce loss of life, property, and harm to the environment. Conducts training and exercise

programs.

Performs additional functions (essential or otherwise) which may be assigned.

Typical Physical Demands

Requires ability to communicate information to staff and general public, including the media, under stressful conditions during emergency situations. Requires the ability to operate radio console, telephone, and computer. Requires lifting objects (such as emergency equipment) weighing up to 50 lbs. Must be able to operate an automobile and/or emergency vehicle.

Work is performed in a highly secured office work area. Requires working from mobile unit or outdoors in all types of weather conditions during emergency and simulated emergency situations. High school diploma and eight (8) years in emergency management or firefighting activities, or any combination of experience and training which enables one to perform the essential job functions. Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license as a condition of continued employment.

National Parks were designated in order to protect beautiful areas for the benefit of the nation. They came about as a result of the 1949 National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act, which put a legislative framework in place for the establishment of National Parks in England and Wales.

The first two National Parks were designated in 1951 and in 1957 the Bannau Brycheiniog National Park was designated covering an area of some 520 square miles (1346 sq. kilometres). Until 1995 the Bannau Brycheiniog National Park Authority was a joint committee of the then local County Councils until the Environment Act of that year laid down legislation to establish National Park Authorities as independent, special purpose Local Authorities.

Job Purpose

To deal with all aspects of Planning development management casework in the National Park and on the fringes of the National Park
To assist the Principal Planning Officers in managing the Planning Development Management function in order to deliver a quality planning service, to achieve and maintain high levels of performance.
To help to ensure that the Authority’s statutory responsibilities are carried out in accordance with Government legislation, policy, procedure and guidance and accord with National Park statutory purposes.
To help to ensure that the Planning service is efficient, effective, responsive, fair, inclusive and open to examination

MAIN DUTIES

Undertake the processing of Development Control casework, including but not limited to complex and major planning and related applications, advertisement consents, conservation area consent. listed building consent applications and planning enforcement matters.
Carry out site inspections, supervision and instructions in respect of consultations, preparation of reports and recommendations. Presentation of nondelegated applications and other development control related matters to Planning Committee.
Peer review delegated decision reports and planning contravention notices on behalf of the Principal Planning Officers and the Head of Development Management in line with the Scheme of Delegation.
To undertake when appropriate, EIA screening and provide EIA screening and scoping opinions formally on behalf of the Authority.
Negotiating with agents, developers, internal consultees and statutory bodies in respect of all planning related work, including development plan preparation, planning applications, pre-application enquiries, the negotiation of Section 106 Agreements and providing design and sustainable development advice.
Dealing with preliminary and formal pre-application enquiries in respect of developments within the National Park and major developments on the fringes of the National Park

A good telephone manner and ability to deal diplomatically with the public, National Park Members and staff
Current driving licence
Welsh Level 1

Membership of the RTPI
Knowledge of the Brecon Beacons National Park and its statutory
Familiarity with Sustainability Appraisals
Current driving licence
Welsh Level 2

jobs.title: Assistant Planner
jobs.description:
Weekly Hours: 37.5 Hours / Week

Title: Assistant Planner

Location: Town Hall

Bargaining Unit: Non-Union

Hiring Range: $66,004.06 - $69,784.00 Annually (DOQ)

Department & Supervisor: Planning & Economic Development Director

Summary

The Town of Shrewsbury is seeking a motivated Assistant Planner to join our dedicated, highly collaborative Planning and Economic Development department. Working alongside our Director, Assistant Director, co-Assistant Planner, and Administrative Assistant, you will play a central role in driving high-visibility municipal initiatives, including Comprehensive Master Planning, Multi-Use Trail expansions, Complete Streets projects, and more.

This position offers the perfect blend of technical land-use management, creative project leadership, and career growth. You will contribute to initiatives involving transportation, land use, housing, economic development, and project management. Serving as a crucial liaison to key boards such as the Planning Board, Zoning Board of Appeals, Affordable Housing Trust, and Community Preservation Committee, you will guide applicants, facilitate public engagement, and help shape sustainable policy. The Planning & Economic Development Department offers an environment where you can sharpen your technical skills, grow as a municipal leader, and actively shape the future of Shrewsbury.

What You'll Do

Assist with community outreach initiatives, comprehensive master plan development, open space and recreation planning, drafting and revising bylaws and zoning amendments, conducting economic development research, and identifying, applying for, and administering grant opportunities.
Maintain accurate records of active and past projects, prepare and track legal notices and advertisements, assist applicants with completing submissions, and ensure compliance with conditions of approval.
Facilitate plan reviews by coordinating input from Town departments, including the Engineering Division, Conservation Commission, Building Inspector, and external consultants. Assist with community outreach and engagement strategies including in person presentations, charrettes and social media postings.
Serve as a resource for residents, landowners, and developers, providing guidance on permitting and economic development matters via phone, email, and in person. Help facilitate public discussion on critical local projects.
Provide comprehensive staff support to land use boards and committees, including preparing meeting agendas and materials, documenting outcomes, and ensuring follow-up. Help facilitate local decision making processes and develop data driven solutions based on community input.
Review and approve building permits tied to land use decisions using the Town’s permitting system. Ensure projects align with local conditions of approval and help guide the development process through implementation.

Qualifications

Master’s degree in planning, geography, landscape architecture, public administration, or related field preferred, with 1 - 3 years of experience in municipal or consulting planning, or any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Valid Massachusetts driver’s license.

Work Hours & Benefits

The Assistant Planner works in a very collaborative team environment from a shared office space at Shrewsbury Town Hall with the staff from both the Planning & Building Inspection departments. Standard work hours are Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM; Tuesday from 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM; and Friday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. The Assistant Planner may attend board and committee meetings as well as community events regarding new developments and is paid for this time through a stipend (and overtime if the meeting runs long).

The Town of Shrewsbury offers a comprehensive benefits package featuring health insurance, a public pension system, generous paid time off (vacation and sick leave), professional development opportunities, and an extensive Employee Assistance Program. Additionally, Shrewsbury is one of the first municipalities in the Commonwealth to provide employer-funded Paid Family & Medical Leave, allowing eligible employees to take paid leave without requiring employee-paid contributions.

How To Apply

If you are a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can balance competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, have a growth mindset, and a passion for community development, we encourage you to apply.

To learn more about this position please review the full job description. When applying for this position a cover letter and resume may be sent via email to Lilianne Exinor, Human Resources Coordinator, at jobs@shrewsburyma.gov indicating the position you are applying for in the subject line. The initial review of applicants will begin on September 14, 2026. The position is open until filled.

jobs.description:
DO YOU HAVE HANDS-ON DEMAND PLANNING AND FORECASTING EXPERIENCE?

The Wheel Group is hiring a Demand Planning Analyst to own SKU-level forecasting, maintain an 18-month rolling demand forecast, and help ensure the right inventory is in the right place at the right time across multiple distribution locations.

This is a hands-on forecasting role requiring direct experience building and maintaining demand forecasts, analyzing historical sales, seasonality, promotions, and new product launches, and measuring forecast accuracy using metrics such as MAPE/WMAPE and forecast bias.

WHAT DRIVES US

Founded in 1997, The Wheel Group is a leading designer, developer, and owner of aftermarket automotive wheel, tire, and accessory brands, with a focus on quality, innovation, and performance. Headquartered in Ontario, California, with 15 distribution centers throughout the U.S. and Canada as well as a QC, engineering and support services office in Shanghai, China, TWG serves a diverse base of customers across North America and globally.

TAKING THE WHEEL

We are seeking a Demand Planning Analyst to drive SKU-level forecasting and inventory planning across our growing automotive aftermarket business. This role will own and maintain an 18-month rolling demand forecast, analyzing historical sales, seasonality, promotions, new product launches, and demand trends to ensure the right inventory is available across our multi-warehouse distribution network.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Finance through the monthly S&OP process, monitor forecast accuracy and bias, and turn demand insights into actionable inventory plans that support growth and service-level targets.

HOW YOU'LL SHAPE THE FORECAST

Develop and maintain SKU-level forecasts across product categories, regions, and channels.
Manage an 18-month rolling forecast incorporating historical data, seasonality (e.g., winter/summer demand), promotions, and product lifecycle.
Adjust forecasts for fitment-driven demand variability and new product launches.
Participate in monthly S&OP to align demand, supply, and financial plans.
Partner with Sales and Marketing to capture market intelligence and promotional impact.
Provide data-driven recommendations and challenge assumptions.
Analyze demand trends, seasonality, and regional/locations performance.
Track forecast accuracy (MAPE/WMAPE), bias, and service metrics.
Deliver regular reports and dashboards to support decision-making.
Improve forecasting models, tools, sales consensus and planning processes.
Support optimization of demand planning systems and reporting automation.

WHAT'S IN YOUR PLANNING TOOLBOX

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, or related field.
5+ years in demand planning or supply chain planning experience.
Automotive aftermarket or CPG experience preferred.
Experience managing large SKU portfolios and multi-location networks.
Advanced Excel Formula (Power Query/Power Pivot).
Experience with ERP/planning systems
Familiarity with Power BI or similar tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective cross-functional communication and collaboration.
Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple priorities.
Success Metrics
Forecast Accuracy (MAPE / WMAPE)
Service Level / Fill Rate
Inventory Turns & Working Capital
Reduction in Excess & Obsolete Inventory

based at The Wheel Group’s headquarters in Ontario, California
. This role is not remote or hybrid.

This is a great opportunity to join an ambitious deep-tech start-up in a dynamic and mission-driven environment, driving our growth from a start-up to a scale-up 🚀
You will also be helping to solve one of the oldest problems of mankind and potentially save the economy billions - not bad right? 🤘

jobs.title: OR1 Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About KARL STORZ

From the operating room to surgery centers—and everywhere in between—KARL STORZ North America is a global leader in medical technology and advanced visualization solutions. We design specialty innovations, smart instruments and devices, integrated ecosystems, and intelligent imaging—to build a more connected, software-enabled operating room.

As an independent, family-owned MedTech company, we ambitiously think in generations instead of quarters to improve patients' lives around the world.

About The Role

The Customer Success Manager plays a critical role in managing the overall growth, effectiveness, and profitability of Operating Room installation projects within their region while delivering world-class customer service. This role leads the regional effort to ensure timely, accurate Operating Room installations with a strong focus on customer success and satisfaction, and works to maintain continuous alignment with the service and deployment teams to ensure a best-in-class experience. The Customer Success Manager reports to the Customer Success Regional or National Manager.

This is a remote position requiring up to 90% travel to Texas, Okalhoma, and Louisiana areas.

What You'll Do

Sales & Sales-Marketing Support

Engage with the sales team on proposal development and accurate estimating, as needed.
Collaborate monthly with sales to ensure alignment on all customer deliverables and prevent negative gross profit impact.
Support other business development needs for sales and marketing as needed by management.

Technical Expertise

Maintain expert competency in how the entire integration product portfolio integrates and functions.
Complete all trainings assigned through the OR1 training department, and pursue outside training opportunities to evolve technical expertise.
Demonstrate technical competency through successful installs with minimal service tickets during the warranty period, and low change orders per project relative to national standards.
Understand the basics of hospital construction, and maintain expert competency in cable management and termination.

Project Management

Lead project planning sessions and manage project progress to ensure deadlines are met.
Manage relationships with clients and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Oversee all incoming and outgoing project documentation, and design risk mitigation plans for each project.
Deliver projects on time, within budget, and in line with national KPI standards for Customer Success.

Customer Satisfaction & Success

Ensure customers experience a best-in-class installation, including clear, well-documented communication.
Monitor, collect, and report on customer feedback post-installation to identify process improvement opportunities, proactively soliciting and working to resolve negative feedback.
Help maintain KARL STORZ's #1 ranking in customer satisfaction by turning customers into lifelong advocates.
Deliver customer training in a timely, comprehensive manner, and confirm and document product utilization post-install.

What You Bring

3–5 years of experience in consulting, project delivery, or project management.
5–7 years of experience in a role requiring technical acumen in AV or IP.
Field-based project and program-level management experience.
A Bachelor's degree in Construction Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or 5 years of experience with the preferred hard skills in place of a degree.
Willingness to travel up to 90%, with a good driving record.
Ability to work in and around hospital personnel, sensitive medical equipment, and patients; this is a safety-sensitive position.
Knowledge and experience in the medical device and/or healthcare marketplace is a plus.
Holistic understanding of cable terminations and handling (cable pull, solder, crimp, compression, and punch-down connections for audio, video, network, control, and power devices) is a plus.
Holistic understanding of cable media (Coax, Mini-Hi-Res, Copper, Multi-Conductor, CAT-5/6, and Fiber Optic) is a plus.
Advanced knowledge of control systems, power amplifiers, digital signal processors, video matrix switchers, video scalers, PC interfaces, computer controls, and digital video recorders is a plus.

What Will Make You Successful

Demonstrated outstanding personal leadership and a true team-player mindset, with excellent interpersonal skills across internal and external executives.
Intellectual curiosity and creativity in developing new approaches to improve the customer experience.
A sense of urgency and healthy impatience with the status quo.
Comfort operating in ambiguous or high-stress situations.
Track record of working collaboratively in a matrixed environment and driving project/process improvement.
Excellent, proven communication and organizational skills, with the ability to multitask effectively.
Highest standards of ethical behavior.

Why KARL STORZ?

Join KARL STORZ and be part of a team creating medical innovations that truly make a difference. Beyond technology, you'll be part of a culture that values talent as its greatest asset, empowering you to contribute to a mission that improves patient care worldwide.

Ready to make an impact? Apply to be our next OR1 Customer Success Manager and help us build the future of MedTech together.

Experience supporting proposal development, client presentations, business development activities, or thought leadership

jobs.title: Compliance Consultant, Senior
jobs.description:
VARITE is looking for a qualified  Compliance Consultant, Senior 
for one of its clients located in Oakland, CA.  

WHAT THE CLIENT DOES? 

A major utility company that provides electricity and natural gas services to millions of customers. It operates a vast energy infrastructure, including power plants, transmission lines, and gas pipelines.

WHAT WE DO? 

Established in the Year 2000, VARITE is an award-winning minority business enterprise providing global consulting & staffing services to Fortune 1000 companies and government agencies. With 850+ global consultants, VARITE is committed to delivering excellence to its customers by leveraging its global experience and expertise in providing comprehensive scientific, engineering, technical, and non-technical staff augmentation and talent acquisition services. 
HERE'S WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

Position Description

You will provide strategic and tactical guidance on enhancing the development, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of various foundational elements within client’s compliance program framework. You will apply deep technical knowledge of compliance, risk management, and quality assurance to ensure consistent interpretation and application of compliance program maturity standards across Electric Compliance sub-functions and key partner teams. You partner closely with Electric leaders to evaluate compliance maturity performance, perform gap analyses to identify gaps and develop mitigation plans. You lead key compliance management workstreams that enable Electric coworkers to conduct business in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and standards, and to identify, manage, and mitigate risk. You will help strengthen Electric’s compliance program by guiding program development, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic guidance, coaching, and hands-on support to Electric sub-functions to strengthen and mature the compliance program and improve performance;
Develop innovative tools and solutions to support/improve compliance program maturity
Assess Electric sub-function compliance programs;
Perform compliance validation activities and testing controls for design and operating effectiveness;
Supports the development and implementation of Electric’s Compliance Controls Program by providing expert advisory support to cross-functional partners (operations, engineering, SMEs, compliance support teams) to strengthen controls, evidence capture, process consistency, and develop compliance metrics;
Leads or supports maintaining a complete and accurate inventory of regulatory requirements, including identifying requirement owners, and mapping requirement to guidance documents, controls, and trainings;
Performs and oversees analysis of compliance metrics, evidence, and documentation to identify gaps, trends, and areas for improvement;
Develops and/or supports maintenance of guidance documents, procedures, templates, and job aids that support compliance maturity;
Identifies new or changing regulatory, operational, or risk concerns that may impact maturity expectations and recommends updates to programs or tools;
Conducts and supports compliance reviews with Electric sub-function leaders, facilitating compliance assessments and recommending corrective actions aligned to regulatory requirements and risk priorities;
Prepares and delivers clear, executive-ready reports and briefings on compliance maturity performance, risks, and opportunities for improvement;
Serves as a subject matter expert on compliance program maturity practices, supporting knowledge sharing/benchmarking across the organization;
Evaluate and analyze regulatory requirement and internal commitment challenges to determine extent of condition and remediation efforts;
Develop and present program challenges and program improvement recommendations to directors and officers;
Works independently with minimal guidance on complex risk and compliance issues with critical impact;
Develops and coordinates preparation of presentation materials for various levels of management up to and including senior vice president;
Leads and develops materials for training and educating coworkers about compliance management principles; and
Assist with other compliance-related projects and activities as directed.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO WIN: 

TOP THINGS LOOKING FOR:

(1) Problem-solving: Analyzing complex issues, identifying root causes, and developing and implementing effective solutions;
(2) Critical thinking: Evaluating information, distinguishing between valuable requirements and lower priorities, and thinking logically to analyze data thoroughly; and
(3) Strategic Thinking & Planning: The ability to see the "big picture" and ensure all projects within the program map directly to organizational goals.

TOP SKILL SETS LOOKING FOR:

(1) Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability;
(2) Strong understanding of utility operations and asset management, with the ability to translate regulatory expectations into field-executable strategy; and
(3) Demonstrated success leading cross-functional, high-impact initiatives through risk-based planning, change leadership, and strategic execution.

Education
: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Experience
: 5+ years of related experience or equivalent with steady progression of responsibilities

Desired
Master’s degree in engineering, economics, business administration or job-related field
Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability
Strong understanding of utility operations and asset management, with the ability to translate regulatory expectations into field-executable strategy
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional, high-impact initiatives through risk-based planning, change leadership, and strategic execution
Executive communication skills and presence, with experience delivering high-impact presentations and updates to senior leadership and external stakeholders
Ability to align compliance strategy with enterprise goals, influencing direction across functions through collaboration, insight, and strategic clarity
Strong problem-solving, project/change management, and communication skills
Deep knowledge of utility regulatory frameworks (e.g., CPUC, FERC, NERC, WECC) and how they inform enterprise compliance strategy
Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability

Pay Range: $58-60/Hr on W2
If this opportunity interests you, please respond by clicking on EasyApply.  

BENEFITS:  

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families. Eligible employees may receive:  
Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision coverage  

Retirement Plans: Participation in a company-sponsored retirement savings plan. 

Legal Service Plans: Offering access to attorneys for legal advice and representation. 

Know someone who would be perfect for this role? Refer them to us and if they are hired, you could be eligible for our employee referral bonus! Help us grow our team with top talent from your network. 
VARITE is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status
