With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively.

Klipboard is a global, growing business that embraces AI and emerging technologies to enhance customer outcomes, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We’re looking for people who are curious about or fluid with AI, open to change, and excited to learn how technology can improve the way we work and help our customers which is always supported by strong human insight and communication.

Klipboard’s brand is designed to bring together our expertise across Distribution, Automotive, Retail, Rental, Transport Management, Manufacturing, and Field Service Management.

Our passion is to provide customers with an advantage in their incredibly competitive world. We have done this so far by providing flexible, industry specific solutions; software, technology, advice, guidance and expertise built over 40 years of servicing their specific market.

As an Implementation Consultant, you will lead the successful implementation of the Rental product suite for customers through a mix of on-site and remote delivery. You will manage projects autonomously, guide customers through change, deliver training, and use your consultancy and technical knowledge to ensure each implementation achieves its intended outcomes. This is a hybrid role suited to someone who enjoys working directly with customers, solving practical delivery challenges and keeping projects moving in a fast-paced environment. Experience with technology rollouts, implementation delivery and tools such as SQL will be valuable, but what matters most is a passion for IT, strong client management skills and the confidence to handle competing priorities, difficult conversations and conflict resolution professionally.

Why join us
: You will join a specialist software business with an established customer base, recognised products and a collaborative Professional Services team. The role offers variety across customer projects, the opportunity to build deep product and sector expertise, and the chance to make a visible impact by helping customers adopt systems that support their day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure projects are implemented within agreed timelines, escalating risks or delays promptly where required.
Manage multiple projects of varying scope and size simultaneously.
Own the full implementation lifecycle for the Rental product suite.
Training customers both on-site and remote as determined by the project scope.
Prepare and conduct project kick-off meetings.
Monitor, track and report delivery activity and project status.
Manage/document/escalate delivery risks and issues to your line manager.
Utilise correct tools and processes to ensure project success.

Skills, Knowledge And Experience

Experience managing or supporting software implementation projects, with strong organisational skills, clear communication, attention to detail and the ability to solve problems throughout the project lifecycle.
Full driving licence required, as the role may involve travel to customer sites.
Fluent in English and Dutch

Nice to have

Understanding of ERP systems and their delivery (any software implementation is great).
Experience working independently on software implementations is desirable, particularly in roles where you have managed delivery directly without line management responsibility.
Exposure to SQL Server databases and Crystal Reports or similar.
Commercially Aware.
Forward thinking/proactive nature.

What do we offer?

An engaging, challenging, and autonomous role at a dynamic IT company with a culture of direct, open communication and an informal atmosphere. After all, a pleasant work environment helps you realize your ambitions!

A competitive salary;
8% holiday allowance;
An attractive bonus scheme;
26 vacation days (based on a 40-hour week) and the option to purchase additional days;
A pension scheme for your retirement;
WIA gap insurance (disability income protection);
A laptop;
Travel or public transport allowance—we are located right next to the train station;
Flexible working hours and a good work-life balance;
An office workspace with friendly colleagues, plus the option to work from home part of the time;
Training: Plenty of opportunities for personal development in a way that suits you;
Extras: Fresh fruit, soup, soft drinks/juice, table football, social drinks, and a host of fun, inspiring (international) colleagues who could easily become friends.

Company Info

You may also have seen from our recent posts that we are excited to begin sharing our new company name – Klipboard. Kerridge Commercial Systems (KCS) is becoming Klipboard and our new brand is designed to bring together our expertise across distribution, automotive, retail, rental, transport management, manufacturing, and field service management. We have offices based across the world and we are looking for talented individuals to join our growing teams. Due to our growth over the last few years it is an exciting time to join us as we enter our next chapter! At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."

Equal Opportunities

As a global company, we value and respect the diversity of our workforce, aiming to empower everyone to embrace each other's differences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are integral to our company and culture. We recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce, where creativity and valuing differences enable us all to thrive and sparks innovation.

If you require any help, adjustments and/or support during the interview and offer process then please advise our TA or HR team.

Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed requirement. However, we recognise that skills and experience come in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every criterion. If you are passionate about this role and believe you have the right mindset and transferrable skills, we would love to hear from you!

To all recruitment agencies: Klipboard does not accept agency speculative resumes. At present we only accept CV’s from Agencies on our PSL who have been assigned specific position/s. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site or direct to Klipboard employee as this does not constitute an introduction and Klipboard retrospectively will not be liable for any candidate ownership or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Principal Urban Designer
jobs.description:
Location/s:
London, Bristol, Cardiff, Liverpool, Manchester, Birmingham; UK

Recruiter contact:
Aoife Cullen

Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices.

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant.

About The business unit 

The Buildings Unit (BLD) has a major presence in Mott MacDonald's regional offices throughout the UK and mainland Europe, providing a wide range of diverse and transferable cross-sector skills across five key Sectors; Advisory, Built Environment, Energy, Transportation and Water. We also provide local services to customers and technical leadership to the rest of the Group in these sectors.

Overview Of The Role

This role sits within the cities team which forms part of the Building and Cities Unit. Our aim is to fully realise the potential of our front end consultancy skills to increase our market profile in cities based work from the earliest stages of strategy development and project creation.

Urban designers are an integral part of our cities business. They work alongside town planners and place economists to provide public sector clients with integrated masterplanning and placemaking services across the UK and internationally.

This role is being created to support the rapid development of our cities team and provide greater junior level urban design staff capacity to respond to existing client requirements and emerging opportunities and expand technical resource capacity.

Mott MacDonald’s cities team undertakes projects spanning a range of complex urban contexts including:
Town centre and urban regeneration
Transport hubs and Transit orientated development
Mixed use urban quarters and neighbourhood

The post holder will support senior staff in the preparation of town centre strategies, site and area based masterplans, development frameworks, feasibility studies and public realm concept designs. All projects are likely to involve stakeholder and community engagement.

Significant career development opportunities will be available including involvement in a diverse portfolio of project work, development of analytical and delivery focused urban design skills, integrated multi-disciplinary masterplanning and the production of high quality graphic outputs. There will be opportunities to progress to more senior urban design roles offering greater levels of responsibility including stakeholder and client liaison.

Key responsibilities and duties include:
Support business development including internal and external client relationship building
Support the preparation of winning bids including the co-ordination of multidisciplinary inputs and sub consultants
Contribute to resource planning
Project manage allocated placemaking and masterplanning projects including commercial and business system requirements and client liaison supporting senior staff
Prepare key urban design outputs including reports, spatial frameworks, masterplans, site feasibility studies, design guidance
Prepare and deliver project presentations to clients, working groups, stakeholder meetings etc
Undertake stakeholder and community engagement to support the production of the above
Guide and supervise junior urban designers in the production of urban design outputs ensuring that QA and graphic standards are maintained
Contribute to the development of Mott MacDonald’s cities business and raising the profile of urban design skills and services within the company and within the market

Candidate specification

Requirements:
Degree in town planning, landscape architecture or architecture
A post graduate qualification in urban design (Post Graduate diploma or MA)
A minimum of 7 to10 years post qualification experience with a proven track record of relevant skills and experience
Chartered membership of a relevant professional institute e.g. MRTPI, MLI, RIBA
Worked within a consulting environment on development-led Urban Design projects
Be able to demonstrate good design outcomes in previous projects and articulate how their input helped to guide the client, regulatory authorities, and support consultants to the end result
A strong portfolio showing a selection of urban design and masterplanning work. International project experience is desirable but not essential. Examples that demonstrate multi-disciplinary and collaborative team working and public sector and local authority clients should be emphasised
Experience in delivering projects at a variety of scales and in a range of contexts including urban regeneration, town and city centres, transit orientated development, growth areas
Excellent ability to develop, draw and communicate urban design and placemaking ideas from appraisal of the local context and early concept development to design development and early stage viability. This includes the preparation of written reports
All applicants should have advanced technical abilities and demonstrate proficiency in using: AutoCAD, QGIS, Sketch-up, Adobe Creative Suite package, and Microsoft Office. Hand sketching skills are also desirable
Ability to work well to deadlines
Ability to lead on key aspects of complex multi-disciplinary projects
Ability to lead and mentor junior members of staff (senior-level role)
Experience of working for private and public sector and Local Authority clients
Excellent spoken and written English
A robust understanding of the UK Planning system

UK Immigration

Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

Agile working

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion

We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone
feels they can contribute.

AI Usage

At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

Accessibility

We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you.

We offer some fantastic benefits including:

Financial wellbeing

We match employee pension contributions between 4.5% and 7%.
Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long-term illness or injury.
Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.

Employee Ownership

Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long-term impact and contribution.
Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.
For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.

Health and wellbeing

Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.

Lifestyle

A minimum of 33-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers.
Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high-street retailers.

Enhanced family and carers leave

Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.
We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing.

Learning and development

Primary annual professional institution subscription.
A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options.

Networks, communities, and social outcomes

Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Gold Award holders in the MOD Employer Recognition Scheme, supported by our dedicated internal Armed Forces Network.
Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.

Apply now, or for more information about our application process, click here.

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst - GRC
jobs.description:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

Location:
London - 2 days per week

Reports to:
Head of Technology Risk and Assurance

The role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented GRC Analyst to join our Technology Risk team. This is a vital, hands-on role supporting the Head of Technology Risk and Delivery Assurance in executing our wider tech risk roadmap and maintaining a secure, compliant environment.
This role requires someone who is a confident communicator, comfortable owning projects, and motivated to develop and establish themselves within the field of GRC (governance, risk & compliance) and information security.
As a GRC Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in the day-to-day implementation and management of key systems and processes at Rightmove. A significant part of the role involves acting as a bridge between compliance requirements and our technical teams. You will be responsible for implementing and running governance and security projects, translating requirements into actionable outputs that embed seamlessly into our product and engineering workflows.
This is an excellent opportunity for a tech-savvy professional to help foster a culture where compliance enables, rather than hinders, product development.

What You’ll Be Doing

Implementation of critical projects: Deliver large-scale updates to processes and systems across multiple departments, such as Business Resilience and Risk Management
Process translation: Act as a liaison between security/legal/compliance functions and other Rightmove Departments, translating GRC requirements into clear technical specifications, user stories, and actionable tickets
Risk assessments & audits: Support internal and external audits, identify vulnerabilities, and collaborate with technical teams to implement appropriate controls
Delivery support: Contribute to the Technology Risk strategy by rolling out frameworks, tracking metrics, and embedding automated compliance practices into workflows
Process integration: Work closely with various teams to integrate compliance requirements into existing ways of working (e.g. Agile/Jira), ensuring a frictionless approach to GRC
System resilience: Support due diligence on software, technical partners, and business continuity processes to strengthen system resilience

We’re looking for someone with

Collaboration and communication: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across technical, compliance, and legal teams
Project management fundamentals: Experience working in software environments, managing project lifecycles and stakeholders
Technical fluency: A solid understanding of modern technology teams and development processes, with the ability to translate complex compliance risks into developer-friendly language
Pragmatic mindset: A problem-solving approach, balancing robust security requirements with efficient product delivery
Process focus: Ability to understand technical workflows and design compliance processes that enhance rather than disrupt team efficiency

What You’ll Bring To The Role

Demonstrable experience (typically 2–4 years) in a project management, GRC, or security-related role
Familiarity with information security, privacy, or compliance-based projects
Experience reporting to stakeholders at all levels of the business
Familiarity with Agile tools (e.g. Jira) and embedding requirements into development backlogs
A proactive, results-oriented mindset with a passion for building strong team cultures

Nice To Have

Hands-on experience with security frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2

Our Approach to AI

At Rightmove, we believe software and product are ultimately people problems, and everything we build aims to improve the lives of others. We see AI as a helpful way to create more space for the human side of our work, from understanding real needs to making sure we are solving the right problems in the right way. There is an expectation that you are proactive in exploring how AI can support your own workflow and productivity, and that you approach it with curiosity and an open mind.

Our vision is to give everyone the belief that they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust and belief to make it happen.

We're home to the UK's largest choice of properties, and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what's on the market.

Despite This Growth, We’ve Remained a Friendly, Supportive Place To Work, With Employee #1 Still Working Here! We’ve Done This By Placing The Rightmove Hows At The Heart Of Everything We Do. These Are The Essential Values That Reflect Our Culture, And Include

We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.
We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.
We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.
We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.
We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact.

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 88% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work
, we’re clearly doing something right!

If all this has caught your eye, you may well be a Rightmover in the making...

People are the foundation of Rightmove - We’ll help you build a career on it.

What We Offer

Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.
Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.
27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.
Contributory stakeholder pension.
Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.
Competitive compensation package.

Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.
Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.
Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.
We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
About Simplified Energy

Simplified Energy is a pioneering technology company based in London, dedicated to developing innovative digital tools tailored for renewable energy installers. Our platform serves a diverse range of services including solar panel installation, battery storage solutions, heat pumps, and electric vehicle charging stations. By streamlining the quoting process, enhancing customer engagement, and improving operational efficiency, we empower trade-background business owners to grow their renewable energy businesses more effectively. As a small but rapidly expanding team, we pride ourselves on moving swiftly, maintaining high standards, and delivering products that truly meet our customers' needs. Our commitment is to support practical, straightforward professionals who value reliable, easy-to-use software and personalized support, ensuring their success in the renewable energy sector.

About The Role

We are seeking a dedicated Customer Success and Support Specialist to join our dynamic team. In this hybrid role based in London, you will be the primary point of contact for a select group of customers, guiding them through onboarding, ensuring they derive maximum value from our platform, and providing ongoing support. Your responsibilities will encompass both proactive engagement and reactive troubleshooting, ensuring a seamless experience for our users. You will conduct onboarding calls to familiarize new customers with our tools, such as Instant Quote Tools, Customer Portals, and Proposal features, while also maintaining regular check-ins to monitor account usage and address any challenges. Additionally, you will handle inbound support inquiries via email and live chat, diagnosing issues, resolving straightforward problems directly, and escalating complex bugs to our development team using Linear. Your proactive approach and ownership mindset will be vital in building strong, trust-based relationships, helping customers optimize their use of our platform and resolving issues efficiently. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with our product and engineering teams, contribute to continuous improvement, and grow into a senior customer success position as the company scales.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have prior experience in a customer-facing role, such as support, account management, or customer success, preferably within the renewable energy industry or a fast-growing startup environment. You should be confident conducting calls and meetings independently, with excellent communication skills to clearly explain technical concepts and solutions. Familiarity with software platforms, especially tools like Linear, HubSpot, Slack, or similar, is essential. A solid understanding of how renewable systems such as solar, battery storage, heat pumps, or EV charging work will be advantageous. You should be highly organized, capable of managing multiple support tickets and accounts simultaneously without losing attention to detail. Proactivity is key—anticipating customer needs, identifying recurring issues, and feeding insights back to the team to improve our product and support processes. Experience in the renewable energy sector, particularly working with trade professionals or small businesses, will be highly valued.

Responsibilities

Support

Respond promptly to inbound support queries via email and live chat, providing clear and professional communication.
Diagnose technical issues, resolve those that can be fixed within the platform, and accurately log and escalate bugs to the development team using Linear.
Maintain transparency with customers by providing regular updates, honest timelines, and confirming when issues are resolved.

Onboarding & Account Relationships

Lead onboarding calls to help new customers set up and become confident in using our platform.
Conduct regular check-ins to understand how customers are utilizing the platform, identify any obstacles, and offer tailored guidance.
Assist customers in configuring key features such as Quote Tools, Service Plans, Customer Portals, and Customer Journeys to suit their business needs.
Collaborate with digital agencies managing client platforms to ensure smooth integration and ongoing support.

Process & Knowledge Building

Create and maintain comprehensive help documentation, FAQs, and onboarding materials to enhance the customer experience.
Identify recurring issues, whether related to product bugs or user adoption, and communicate insights to the product team for continuous improvement.

Benefits

Joining Simplified Energy offers a competitive starting salary of around £26,000 per annum, with some flexibility for the right candidate. You will enjoy 25 days of paid holiday annually, fostering a healthy work-life balance. Our team operates in a remote-first environment, providing flexibility to work from anywhere, with optional in-person meetings in London a few days per week. You will have direct access to company founders and the product team, enabling meaningful influence and rapid professional growth. As the company expands, there are opportunities to advance into senior customer success roles or team leadership positions. We also provide a collaborative, innovative environment where your contributions directly impact our product development and customer satisfaction.

Equal Opportunity

Simplified Energy is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences drive innovation and excellence, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to succeed.

**About the Role**



Maidstone Borough Council is a progressive and pro\-active local authority with strong ambitions for Kent’s County Town and surrounding countryside. This is an exciting opportunity for a planner wishing to grow their strategic planning experience.



Maidstone offers a unique opportunity to work on major planning, development and investment projects. We work on a varied canvas – bringing forward significant, high quality growth with associated infrastructure, whilst enhancing our significant local landscapes, heritage and identity.



To help plan pro\-actively, Maidstone Borough’s Local Plan Review was adopted in March 2024 and we are now commencing production of a new Local Plan, as well as bringing forward Article 4 Directions, new strategies for Heritage and Maidstone Town Centre, and assisting with several Neighbourhood Plans. The role will therefore provide excellent experience for an enthusiastic team player and self\-motivated individual within a dynamic environment.



We will accept applications from those seeking a full or part time role for this permanent post and offer a flexible working environment.


**About You:**



To be considered for the Principal Planning Officer role, your education and training will include:


* Degree in Town Planning or Post Graduate qualification in Town Planning
* Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute. Consideration will be given to other relevant professional accreditation holders e.g. RICS/RIBA subject to relevant experience.
* Full Driving Licence


Your experience will include:


* Extensive experience of dealing with complex and sensitive planning issues and preparation of policies and guidance
* Ability to assess and evaluate large quantities of often complex and sometimes conflicting information and data and then find creative solutions and formulate strategic policy and proposals


Additionally, you will have excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.


**About us:**

Maidstone Borough Council is a confident organisation with ambition and aspirations to deliver high quality services to our residents and local businesses. We strive to make the borough an attractive place for all and secure a successful economy. We continue to build on our strengths \- assets, knowledge and expertise and our track record for innovation and improvement to create a financially sustainable future so that we can continue with our undiminished plans.



We will only achieve the results we are aiming for through the talents and hard work of all our people. You are encouraged to become part of our vision and in return you can expect support, training, and fair reward from us. We will give you the opportunity to develop the skills to do your job well and create a positive working environment where your ideas about improving how we do things are valued and we manage the changes needed for new ways of working well.



At Maidstone Borough Council we recognise the importance of flexible working and the benefits this can bring to both our staff and the Council. We know that by offering employees a range of flexible working opportunities we can positively impact their wellbeing and engagement, and drive productivity in return. As such we have developed a highly flexible hybrid working policy, alongside our flexi time and flexible working policies, enabling staff to shape their working patterns around building a greater work life balance.


**Our Offer:**



A range of benefits including:


* Highly flexible hybrid working opportunities – with some office working for the purposes of specific meetings or team working
* 7am to 7pm flexi time to suit personal circumstances for most roles
* Generous holiday entitlement which increases after 5 years LG service plus bank holidays with the option to buy additional leave.
* Additional 3 days leave given to enable a close down of the offices between Christmas and New year.
* Free parking
* Range of flexible working opportunities to accommodate people’s home/work life balance including compressed hours, 9\-day fortnight, part time.
* Invitations to staff events to celebrate success and support wellbeing that include holistic therapies and outdoor activities
* Employee Assistance Programme which provides confidential \& independent information and access to counsellors
* Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) with valuable life cover and financial protection for your family.
* Life Assurance – three times your annual salary (for members of the LGPS)
* Season Ticket Loan \- to help with the cost of your rail/ bus journey, to \& from work
* Lease car salary sacrifice scheme allowing you to lease a brand\-new car. The monthly fee includes insurance, servicing and road tax.

This is an exciting opportunity to join **Ipswich Borough Council** at the start of Local Plan making journey under the new plan\-making system and progress a programme of town centre regeneration. Following a re\-structure and considering these exciting workstreams, we are looking to expand our team with a motivated, ambitious **Senior Planning Officer**.

 **About Ipswich**


Ipswich is one of the fastest growing regional centres in England and is the largest centre in Suffolk for business, culture, entertainment and sports. A university town with a rich culture, heritage, elite sports teams and a thriving Waterfront. It is well connected to London and other parts of the country through strategic rail and road links.


The town is entering an important period, with the Council prioritising the delivery of key Town Centre regeneration and supporting the Ipswich City of Culture bid. Backed by successful Towns Fund investment and a strong regeneration pipeline, Ipswich offers a unique opportunity to help shape a vibrant, resilient and culturally rich town centre.

 **About the role**


The role primarily involves shaping the approach to Town Centre regeneration and the preparation of evidence base studies, monitoring and engagement to progress into the next Ipswich Local Plan, which commenced in June 2026\. By joining us now, you will play a key role from the earliest stages.


There is also significant opportunity to work collaboratively with neighbouring local authorities and Suffolk County Council on strategic planning matters. This role will allow the successful candidate the opportunity to further develop their skill set providing analysis and working to support other officers; report writing; project management; the opportunity to write guidance to expand on planning policy, and to get involved in helping to deliver allocations and regeneration by working with developers and site owners as well as input into master\-planning larger sites.


In addition, the role will also afford the opportunity to work closely with the Council’s busy Development Management team.

 **About you**


We’re looking for an enthusiastic and proactive Town Planner with a relevant degree or post graduate diploma or an NVQ Level 6 qualification in planning or a relevant field. Membership of the RTPI is required or actively being worked towards.


You will have previous Local Plan making experience.


In the context of a strong corporate emphasis on town centre regeneration and growth, we are keen to hear from candidates with experience of, or a strong interest in, town centre policy, regeneration and place\-based planning.


Effective project management and workload skills with a genuine passion for improving our built environment are a must. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with key stakeholders are essential.

 **Why work for us?**


Your hard work will be rewarded with a fantastic benefits package, including:

* a career average pension scheme
* generous holiday entitlement of 26 days (increasing to 32 days after five years of service)
* full payment of annual RTPI membership subscriptions
* free swimming and gym membership
* and flexibility to work from home and in the office.
* excellent travel benefits, including free travel on Ipswich Buses, discounts on Greater Anglia rail season and flexi\-season tickets, access to a cycle\-to\-work scheme
* subsidised parking in Ipswich Borough Council car parks for work and leisure.

  

We place a strong emphasis on personal and professional development and career progression. This is complemented by access to a supportive Employee Assistance Programme.


Join our vibrant team for hybrid working and seize the chance to shape Ipswich’s future. Don’t miss this opportunity to be part of a growing department that’s making Ipswich an even better place to live!

 **For more information**

jobs.title: Principal Planning Officer (Development Management)
jobs.description:
Job Introduction

At Bromsgrove District Council, we believe that great places have the power to transform lives. As a Principal Planning Officer, you will be at the heart of shaping the future of two unique communities \- helping to protect what makes them special, while guiding thoughtful, well\-designed growth for generations to come.
We also believe in **trust, flexibility and balance**. We warmly welcome requests for **100% home working**, **flexible hours**, **compressed weeks**, **part‑time working**, and **job‑share**. We want brilliant people, and we are committed to helping them thrive.**Who are we?**
We are a shared Planning Service across Bromsgrove District Council and Redditch Borough Council \- a partnership built on stability, collaboration and ambition. Our team brings together experienced Planners with new talent at the start of their careers. What connects us is simple: we care deeply about the places we serve, and we support each other to deliver our very best work.**Where are we?**
North Worcestershire offers a landscape rich in character and contrast:* **Bromsgrove**, a beautiful rural district rooted in its historic market town
* **Redditch**, a former market town re\-imagined as a New Town, blending urban energy with green, open landscapes


These are communities with strong identity, proud histories and exciting futures \- places where thoughtful planning truly matters.**What will you be doing?**
This is a role for someone who wants to make a difference.
You will handle a diverse caseload of major and minor schemes that shape the look, feel and opportunity of the District and Borough. Your work will include:* Leading meaningful conversations at the pre‑application stage
* Managing your caseload with confidence and independence, whilst championing high\-quality development
* Ensuring our residents and applicants receive a clear, fair and responsive service
* Robustly defending decisions through the appeal process
* Taking a lead role in planning enforcement to safeguard our environment


You will also help grow the next generation of Planners. Through our established buddy system, you will mentor and support our Planning Officers and Planning Assistants \- sharing your expertise, encouraging their development and helping them build strong, resilient careers.
Our team works primarily from home, but you will have the option of using our Bromsgrove or Redditch offices whenever you wish.**What do you need to be shortlisted?**
To take on this inspiring opportunity, you will need:* A degree\-level (or higher) qualification
* Full Chartered Membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute
* At least three years of planning experience, including one year in Development Management

**Why join us?**
This is more than a job \- it is a chance to help shape the District and Borough with distinct character and significant potential. You will be joining a team that is proud of its work, confident in its direction and committed to supporting each other through periods of change and growth. We offer a workplace where you can stretch your skills, deepen your knowledge, and make a visible impact.
You will also benefit from:* Full payment of RTPI subscription fees
* Certainty and clarity through two adopted Local Plans (January 2017\)
* A home working\-focused culture with all IT equipment provided
* Targeted support for CPD and long\-term progression
* A flexible working scheme that supports real work\-life balance
* 25 days annual leave (rising to 30 days after five years continuous service), plus statutory holidays
* Modern offices in central Redditch, close to public transport and shops
* Historic, characterful offices in Bromsgrove Town Centre
* Free, secure parking at both locations


Your first few weeks will include face\-to\-face training, guidance and support \- ensuring that you feel confident, connected and ready to make your mark. After that, you are free to shape the working pattern that suits you best. **What next?**
Need further information on the duties of this post? Please contact Dale Birch: Development Management Manager on direct line 01527 881341 or email d.birch@bromsgroveandredditch.gov.uk. **The closing date for the receipt of completed applications is midnight on Monday 21 September 2026\.** **The interviews will be held virtually via Microsoft Teams week commencing Monday 28 September 2026 (alternative dates can be made available if requested).**
If this progressive and exciting role interests you, please select the 'Apply' button.
If you experience difficulties applying online then please contact HR at recruitment@bromsgroveandredditch.gov.uk

* **About The Post**
------------------
* **There are two full time and permanent posts available, working 35 hours a week.*****The FTE of each post is negotiable, and the School may appoint more than two part\-time postholders to fill this total.***  

The University of Westminster is seeking to appoint two Lecturers in Urban Planning to join the School of Architecture \+ Cities. These appointments will play a key role in the delivery and development of the MA Urban and Regional Planning and BA Urban Planning and Design, including course and module leadership, while strengthening the School's wider planning provision. The posts are available immediately, and the successful candidates will be expected to take up their appointment as soon as possible to contribute to the new academic year. One post will be to take on leadership of the course for the MAURP, working closely with the Assistant Head of School, Subject Lead and course leaders for the sister apprenticeship course and UG planning course. The number of postholders and their individual FTE will be confirmed during the appointment process, taking into account candidate availability and preferred working patterns.


The School of Architecture \+ Cities is one of the UK's leading built environment schools, bringing together architecture, interiors, planning and related disciplines in a vibrant, practice\-informed and research\-led environment. Based at the Marylebone Campus in central London, the School benefits from strong links to professional practice, a cross\-disciplinary culture and excellent studio and technical facilities. The successful candidates will teach across undergraduate and postgraduate planning courses, supervise dissertation and/or final projects, and contribute to curriculum enhancement and student support, including course and module leadership where required, as well as to the broader scholarly and professional life of the School.



Applicants should have a PhD or equivalent professional or practice\-based experience in planning or a closely related field, together with teaching experience in higher education or equivalent relevant professional experience, and a research, knowledge exchange or professional practice profile appropriate to the post. Experience of postgraduate teaching, supervision and applied, practice\-oriented pedagogy will be an advantage.



The School is seeking candidates with theory\-led, practice\-oriented or mixed profiles who can combine a strong conceptual understanding of planning with knowledge of the workings of the UK planning system. A solid grounding in planning theory and history and in UK planning practice and governance, or specialist strength in one of these domains, will be particularly valued. A desire to lead the course is a requirement for one post. Candidates will also be expected to demonstrate expertise across more than two of the following:



	+ UK planning law, planning policy, development management, plan\-making and planning implementation.
	+ Urban design, site appraisal, delivery, viability or negotiation.
	+ Housing, regeneration and urban change.
	+ Economic development, land and property markets, and local economies.
	+ Regional and strategic planning, devolution, city\-regional governance, and major infrastructure planning and delivery.
	+ Environmental planning, climate mitigation and adaptation, resilience and nature\-based solutions.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **Start here. Grow here.**


AECOM are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our Development Planning and Management Team in the South East, based in either our London, St Albans, Birmingham or Bristol office, to primarily to work on a Spatial Planning Contract for a key strategic client. The role would be providing development management advice to this client to assist them in protecting the operation, safety and future performance of the Strategic Road Network.


The candidate will act as a key team member reviewing relevant planning application documentation associated with development proposals affecting the Strategic Road Network (SRN). The role will include involvement in a range of planning consultations, undertaking high quality technical reviews of transport assessments and associated documents, mentoring junior staff and drawing on technical team’s expertise and building and maintaining client relationships.

*Here’s what you’ll bring:*

**Client and Stakeholder Engagement**: Build and maintain strong relationships with the client team through taking ownership of reviews and associated tasks, strong communication and organisational skills. There will be the opportunity to build experience of communication and liaison with public sector stakeholders, private developers and other third parties.

**Project Delivery:** Assisting the team in the overall delivery of individual tasks, meeting deadlines and managing one’s own workload and the workload of juniors, budget preparation and monitoring. You will undertake the review of transport planning documentation and ensuring the deliverables meet quality, budget, client and timeline requirements.

**Technical Skills:** A good understanding of Transport Assessments and the wider planning process with the ability to critically review third party documents, interrogate calculations, assumptions and associated information and successfully convey the outcomes competently in a Technical Note. It is expected that the candidate would have experience/ understanding of the following:

* Trip Generation
* Trip Distribution/ Assignment
* Junction Capacity Modelling (JUNCTIONS/ LINSIG and awareness of microsimulation/ strategic modelling ideally)
* Mitigation suitability


In addition, awareness of related transport documentation such as DMRB compliance reviews, GG104 Safety Risk Assessments, WCHARs, Road Safety Audits/ Documentation would be beneficial. Knowledge and/ or experience of working within the DCO process and Local Plan Examination process would also be advantageous.

**Come grow with us.**


We develop projects from concept through to operation providing engineering and construction services for multiyear, multimillion\-dollar projects for major rail and transit agencies. Our specialists provide analytical and strategic expertise for every stage of a project


And let's not forget about the perks at AECOM. You'll enjoy a range of core and personalised benefits designed to support your future and well\-being, customized to fit your lifestyle. Take advantage of career development opportunities, our flexible hybrid working model to ensure a work\-life balance that suits your lifestyle, technical practice networks, AECOM University, and volunteering days.

 **Qualifications** **Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?**

*Here’s what we’re looking for:*

  

* Degree in Transport Planning, Civil Engineering, Spatial/ Urban Planning, or a related field
* Membership of a professional body such as the Chartered Institution of Highways and Transportation (CIHT), Transport Planning Society (TPS) or Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport (CILT)
* Excellent team working, written, communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* Awareness/ knowledge of transport planning principles, policies, and regulations in the UK
* Experience and enthusiasm in helping mentor and develop junior staff
* Experience in transport modelling (local, and ideally strategic)
* Proficiency in commonly used transport planning tools and software and excellent knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel


At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.


If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!

**Job Description Summary:**

This is a Full Time, Fixed Term position for 2 years due to funding (any extension dependant on securing further funding) .
  

  

Are you an experienced planning professional looking to help shape the future of Hull? We are seeking a motivated Senior Planning Policy Officer to join our Planning Service and play a key role in the preparation, implementation and monitoring of the new Hull Local Plan. The role also provides a unique opportunity to help deliver an innovative programme that supports the creation of active, healthy and inclusive environments across Hull.
  

  

Working with colleagues across Planning, Public Health, Transport and partner organisations, you will lead on planning policy projects, develop evidence\-based policy, undertake research and engagement activities, and provide expert planning advice. Your work will help ensure that future development supports sustainable growth, creates high\-quality places, and contributes to improving health, wellbeing and active lifestyles across the city.
  

  

The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of the planning system, excellent analytical and communication skills, and the ability to build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders.
  

  

This is an exciting opportunity to influence the future growth and development of Hull, , supporting the delivery of thriving, healthy and sustainable communities while working within a supportive and forward\-thinking team.
  

  

For an informal discussion, please contact Roger Gray on 01482 612 614
  

  

If the postholder requires a Standard or Enhanced DBS disclosure the candidate is required to declare full details of everything on their criminal record unless the conviction/s and/or caution/s are considered “protected” in line with filtering rules for DBS checks.
  

  

ROLE AND PURPOSE
  

  

The post holder will lead on a range of planning policy matters, which are required for the delivery of the Hull Local Plan with significant emphasis on creating active environments and ensuring Active Design principles are embedded in future planning decisions.
  

  

The post holder will focus on building relationships with internal and external partners (including local planning authorities, public health and the active partnership), to design a strategic vision and contribute to the development of workable planning policies, considering all sources of relevant evidence including best practice, data and intelligence.  

**PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:**  

1\. Customer Focus – The post holder will work with national, regional, and sub\-regional government and strategic bodies to inform the planning process, including advising officers and members on national and regional policy developments and contributing to the consultations on behalf of the residents of Hull in relation to active environments.


Co\-ordinates effective and efficient joint working with statutory and other key partners to ensure the highest quality development and place making, helping Planning Officers and Planning Committee assess the quality of development proposals with a particular focus on physical activity, health and wellbeing, health inequalities, and inclusion.


2\. Performance Management – Researches and evaluates trends and background information in formulating realistic planning policy options and choices and recommends solutions on wide ranging matters affecting the long\-term future of the City. Identifying, commissioning and managing consultants for appropriate work tasks. Codesigning, developing, implementing, and evaluating training programmes for Public Health, Planning and Transport Planning practitioners and managers that build a common purpose for healthy place\-making and contribute to integrated working.


Contribute to the ongoing evaluation and continuous learning of the impact of this workstream as part of place\-based expansion.


3\. Statutory Obligations – Lead on relevant sections of the development of Hull’s new Local Plan, particularly in relation to opportunities to create active environments\-write and develop needs led and evidenced based policies.
  

4\. Building common purpose around Public Health and Planning through expanding a partnership approach, within the Local Authority, wider stakeholders and the Active Hull Partnership.


5\. Provision of a constructive input to guide developers towards the highest quality development and place making, helping Planning Officers and Planning Committee assess the quality of development proposals with a particular focus on physical activity, sport, health and wellbeing, health inequalities, and inclusion.


6\. Advising on the potential health impacts of a range of planning activities and workstreams including planning applications, planning policies, regeneration initiatives and associated projects and programmes, including embedding Health Impact Assessments where appropriate.


7\. Developing and influencing planning policy and guidance to ensure that significant weight is attached to place planning for creating active, healthy and inclusive design. Involvement in the development and implementation of the Council’s built facilities strategy and Playing Pitch Strategy.


8\. Attending pre\-application/planning application meetings with developers and their design and planning teams together with the Council’s project team when required. Respond to submitted proposals and planning applications.

To support the Service Manager Strategic Planning and Development and Principal Planning Officer Strategic Planning and Development in preparing the Regional Spatial Strategy for Moray.



To contribute to the overall LDP process, including analysing sites, preparing settlement statements, local policy solutions, preparing and implementing the Delivery Plan and public engagement.



To lead on the preparation of other strategies, masterplans and supporting studies and reports as required.

Self\-confidence

NEW000238 Requisition \#  

**Joining Arup**


Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.


You will join our Newcastle planning team, part of a wider “North” planning network spanning Scotland, the North of England and Northern Ireland. Our planners work on a diverse portfolio of projects, helping shape places, infrastructure and communities through innovative and sustainable development.


Working as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside environmental, transport, design and engineering specialists, you will contribute to projects across sectors including energy, transport, water, science, industry and technology.

  

**The Opportunity**


We are looking for a Town Planner to support the delivery of a wide range of planning projects and help shape sustainable development across the UK.


In this role, you will:


* Support and manage planning applications and development projects, including major and complex schemes


* Contribute to policy development, plan\-making and urban regeneration initiatives


* Prepare and contribute to high\-quality planning reports, statements and technical documents


* Support major infrastructure schemes, including NSIPs and National Developments


* Work closely with clients, stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful outcomes


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.


You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.

  

**Is this role right for you?**


We are looking for people who bring a combination of technical capability, collaboration and a passion for high\-quality planning outcomes:


* A degree in Town Planning (or related discipline) and RTPI membership (or working towards)


* Experience contributing to planning applications and development management projects


* Strong understanding of UK planning legislation, policy and guidance


* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, high\-quality outputs

As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. jobs.title: Assistant Planner - Channel Trading (FTC)
jobs.description:
**Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally\-minded individuals with a passion for fashion.**

**If you enjoy working in a creative, fast\-paced environment, then we would love to hear from you!**

—


We have an exciting opportunity for an **Assistant Planner – Channel Trading (FTC)** in our **London office:**

  

**Department Overview**

Planning supports the business to maximise sales, optimise inventory and drive profitable growth through effective planning and trading. Working closely with Sales, Buying, Operations and other cross\-functional teams, Planning provides the analysis, insight and tools needed to manage performance from market through to in\-season and end\-of\-season trading.  



  

This London\-based role sits within the Trading team, supporting Planners with performance analysis, reporting, planning tools and day\-to\-day trading activity, while helping identify risks, opportunities and actions.  



**What You’ll Do**

**Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

  

**Commercial Planning \& Trading**

* Maintain and actualise sales, stock, WSSI and OTB data, ensuring outputs are accurate and ready for review.
* Produce regular trade reporting and analysis, highlighting key movements, risks and opportunities across sales, stock, sell\-through and availability.
* Support in\-season trading activity including replenishment, ATS, transfers, cancellations, markdowns and end\-of\-season activity.
Support Planners with analysis, follow\-up actions and day\-to\-day trading activity.  
* 

  

**Market \& Planning Support**

* Support market preparation through sales, OTB, WSSI, forecasting, option planning and buying analysis.
* Maintain buying and recap tools, ensuring information is accurate and aligned to agreed plans.
* Prepare analysis and materials for trade, OTB and commercial meetings, supporting actions and follow\-up.
Support the review of buys against OTB, sales expectations and agreed commercial plans, highlighting material variances and B99 requirements.  
* 

  

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

jobs.title: Associate Town Planning
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role in Ramboll’s Town Planning team could be the perfect opportunity.

Your new role

You will bring your knowledge of Town Planning into play as you take a lead role in advising on planning strategy, delivering planning applications, and providing day to day planning advice. You will have the opportunity to drive sustainable change through all stages in the project lifecycle across within development and infrastructure projects.

To succeed in this role, you will be able to apply an excellent understanding of Town Planning in the UK, in all stages of the project lifecycle from early-stage feasibility/risk appraisal, through to delivery of planning conditions, obligations and scheme revision.

You will also need the skills to disseminate changes in the planning system across Ramboll, to Clients and the team in which you will work and help lead; and be able to form and hold good Client relationships.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

Work with Directors to take a lead role in advising on planning strategy and project managing applications and appeals,
Lead others in such work and provide constructive feedback, being a core part of Ramboll’s Town Planning team and be recognised as key person within the team,
Contributing to business development activities, including the preparation of fee proposals, tender submissions, marketing materials and presentations but most importantly, be willing to maintain Client relationships
Support the team’s leadership and wider management with team functions, including mentoring junior members of the team.
Develop relationships, build networks and collaborate with Ramboll technical specialists.
Represent Ramboll at meetings with clients and at networking events.

Your new team

You will be part of our wider Development team, albeit working on both development and infrastructure projects. This is part our Global Impact Assessment Service Line which been especially successful in driving further growth, targeting large, strategic projects – though not exclusively. Our projects are wide ranging and diverse and include housing, mixed use, regeneration, energy, highways and data centres.

More widely, our UK business employs experts 19 locations and covers a breadth of consulting services structured around Town Planning and impact assessment, compliance, strategy and transactions, new initiatives and sustainability, product safety and stewardship, contaminated land, and Water. Ramboll’s clients include UK and global multinationals, utilities, local and central government and international institutions. Ramboll works flexibly and with this you will be part of an exciting team of experts, who respect each other and work towards a common goal.

About You

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. Whilst we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.

These include:

7 years+ of experience
A degree in Town Planning or a related degree and or Post Graduate qualifications in a relevant discipline
Professional Membership of the RTPI
Project delivery and Town Planning experience
Strong communication skills both written and oral, with the ability to liaise with colleagues and maintain good client relationships
A keenness for professional development and progression

What We Can Offer You

Commitment to your development
Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
Flexible work environment
27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Matched pension contributions
Private medical cover and life assurance

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV and cover letter.

We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll’s supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

Ramboll in the United Kingdom

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. Ramboll has a proven track record of sustainable and responsible business and is a top ten engineering and environmental and sustainability consultancy in the UK, with more than 1,500 employees across 16 offices working towards a more sustainable future. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Environment & Health, and Energy. Strong values guide what we do and drive an inclusive, collaborative, and highly flexible culture that values people and ideas. Explore and nurture your own passion, expertise, and creativity at Ramboll through work that benefits our people, partners, nature, and society.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.

Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Shape the Future of Norwich

Norwich City Council is looking for a highly motivated Senior Planner (Development Management)
to play a leading role in delivering a high¿quality, customer¿focused planning service in one of the UK’s most historic and forward¿thinking cities.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced planning professional seeking to take the next step in their career—working on a wide variety of development proposals, regeneration projects, policy work, and cross¿authority initiatives that directly shape the future of Norwich.

Job Description

As a Senior Planner (Development Management)
, you will:

Work independently at a senior professional level to deliver the full range of statutory planning and development management functions.
Provide high¿quality planning advice to applicants, agents, the public, councillors, and other stakeholders.
Process and determine planning applications, negotiate amendments, secure planning obligations, and prepare robust reports and recommendations.
Contribute to planning enforcement by assessing unauthorised development and advising on appropriate actions.
Support preparation, monitoring, and review of spatial planning policies, including work linked to the Local Development Framework.
Present cases at Planning Applications Committee and represent the Council at appeals, hearings, and public inquiries.
Help develop and improve service performance, systems, and workflow management.
Assist in the informal supervision, mentoring, and training of Planners and deputise for the Development Management Team Leader when required.
Work collaboratively across services, with partner authorities (including the Greater Norwich Growth Board), and support wider corporate priorities.
Promote a culture of innovation, customer service, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

About You

You will be an experienced and confident planning professional who can operate effectively at a senior level. You will bring:

Essential Knowledge & Experience

Strong understanding of planning law, development management processes, spatial planning, sustainable development, and urban regeneration.
Significant experience processing planning applications, writing reports, preparing appeal statements, negotiating planning obligations, and providing planning advice.
Experience working with listed buildings and conservation issues.
Familiarity with Environmental Impact Assessment, stakeholder engagement, and service performance requirements.

Skills Required

Skills & Abilities

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present at committees and public meetings.
Strong analytical abilities and confidence interpreting plans, drawings, and technical data.
Ability to negotiate effectively, make sound planning judgments, and manage your own workload to meet deadlines.
Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service.
Ability to mentor colleagues and contribute positively to team development.
Competence using standard office and specialist planning systems, including GIS.

Educational Requirements

Qualifications

A postgraduate degree or diploma in Planning.
Membership of the Royal Town Planning Institute (MRTPI), or the ability and commitment to achieve it.

jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, Civil Government, you will be responsible for managing and expanding relationships with a diverse range of public sector entities across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This includes national/central governments, regional authorities, local municipalities, and key supranational organizations (e.g., Space agencies, Union bodies, and UN programmes).

You will help customers maximize the value of Planet’s imagery and geospatial solutions, ensuring that they can effectively integrate Planet data into their workflows for critical applications such as environmental monitoring, emergency response, land management, maritime surveillance, and sustainable development.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with government entities, have a solid ability to navigate highly complex and varied government structures and decision-making processes, procurement cycles, and the ability to integrate relationships across different countries and cultures. The ability to identify and build connections between ministries, directorates, and stakeholders will be key to driving adoption and impact across government initiatives.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our London, Berlin, or Haarlem office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own

Partner closely with Account Executives to build unified strategies by bringing actionable account insights and forward-looking recommendations to internal syncs.
Map out long-term account trajectories proactively to identify capacity gaps, risks, and expansion opportunities early.
Co-create success plans and QBRs that enable customers to clearly measure and present the business impact and ROI of Planet solutions.
Build strong relationships across complex stakeholder networks, equipping internal champions with the data they need to advocate for the partnership.
Lead cross-functional internal teams through critical account milestones to ensure alignment and clear execution.
Navigate high-stakes customer situations with composure and sound judgment, prioritizing effectively under pressure.

What You Bring

4+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management or a similar customer facing role, ideally supporting government organizations as a customer.

Good working knowledge of remote sensing, GIS, or geospatial imagery products, with the ability to bridge technical workflows with commercial value.
Experience working closely with sales organizations and a firm grasp of commercial business models. Able to act as a true consultative partner who can navigate trade-offs and ensure customer requests align with strategic and financial goals.
Ability to read the room, pick up on what a customer is not saying, and adjust your tone, depth, and brevity depending on whether you are speaking with a technical lead or an executive.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Russian and English.
Willingness to travel to connect with customers and internal teams.

Proficiency in using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Customer Success (CS) tools (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, Zendesk) to manage workflows and report on team metrics.
