This role is designed for someone who wants to build a career in Customer Success and Account Management. You'll develop consultative relationship management skills, learn how enterprise customers measure value, and gain exposure to commercial account planning and growth strategies.

with a very competitive bonus, paid quarterly.

, reducing to 2 days upon successful completion.

What You'll Be Doing..

Supporting the onboarding of new clients to ensure successful adoption of Verdantix research subscriptions and advisory services.
Delivering proactive client engagement through email, phone and virtual meetings to maximise platform usage whilst helping them understand how to navigate, access and apply Verdantix research to meet their business objectives.
Monitoring client engagement and usage data to identify adoption risks and opportunities to improve customer outcomes and assisting with renewal preparation by demonstrating the value client’s have received through their subscription.
Building relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across client organisations and maintaining client satisfaction, customer records, activities and engagement notes within Salesforce.
Identifying opportunities for additional users, research access or advisory engagement and collaborating with Account Managers to support account growth.
Using internal systems and customer engagement tools to manage workload, prioritise client interactions and improve productivity.
Working closely with Research, Sales, Marketing and Product teams to deliver an outstanding client experience.
Continuously developing knowledge of Verdantix research, markets and client challenges to provide increasingly valuable support.

About You..

Passion for building relationships and delivering an exceptional customer experience. Prior experience within customer success/client engagement is essential.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with a confidence in engaging professionals across a range of seniorities.
Naturally organised with excellent attention to detail and enjoys working collaboratively across different teams.
Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to supporting clients.

Strong focus on learning and development with career plans for all employees
Dog-friendly office
Fantastic colleagues with a great sense of humour!

Who We Are..

Verdantix is a trusted intelligence platform. We combine 18 years of independent research with a purpose-built AI platform, giving the world's most innovative corporations, technology and services vendors, and investors insights they can act on. Our team is a curious, collaborative group of expert analysts, data engineers, commercial specialists, creative professionals and thought leaders working together to help clients achieve their most important goals.

At Verdantix, innovation, technology, and human insight come together to solve problems that really matter. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Over Shiftbase

Shiftbase bouwt de self-driving assistent voor bedrijven die in shifts werken. Wij geloven dat planning, urenregistratie, salarisverwerking en HR-administratie uiteindelijk grotendeels vanzelf moeten gaan. Daarom bouwen we software die steeds meer werk uit handen neemt, zodat onze klanten minder tijd kwijt zijn aan administratie en meer tijd overhouden voor hun mensen en hun bedrijf.

Een klant binnenhalen is pas het begin. Succes betekent dat klanten snel live zijn, het platform actief gebruiken en hun inzet van Shiftbase stap voor stap uitbreiden.

Je beheert een portefeuille klanten van begin tot eind. Je helpt klanten snel en succesvol live, zorgt dat ze het maximale uit Shiftbase halen en ziet op tijd waar extra aandacht nodig is. Je werkt op basis van klantsignalen, zodat je tijd investeert waar die de meeste impact heeft.

Wat je gaat doen

Klanten succesvol live brengen.
Je begeleidt nieuwe klanten van de eerste implementatie tot een succesvolle livegang. Je adviseert over de inrichting, configureert de omgeving, verzorgt de technische onboarding en zorgt dat teams met vertrouwen aan de slag kunnen.

Je eigen klantenportefeuille beheren.
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een vaste groep klanten en weet wat er bij hen speelt. Je houdt zicht op gebruik, klanttevredenheid en verlengingen en zorgt ervoor dat je portfolio gezond blijft.

Werken op basis van klantsignalen.
Je werkt niet simpelweg een bellijst af. Je gebruikt data en signalen uit het product om te bepalen welke klanten op dat moment jouw aandacht nodig hebben en waar je de meeste impact kunt maken.

Churn voorkomen voordat het een probleem wordt.
Je herkent risico's vroeg, gaat het gesprek aan om de oorzaak te begrijpen en onderneemt actie voordat een klant afhaakt.

Accounts laten groeien.
Je ziet waar extra functionaliteiten of add-ons waarde kunnen toevoegen, bespreekt die mogelijkheden met de klant en zorgt dat commerciële kansen niet blijven liggen.

De stem van de klant vertegenwoordigen.
Je deelt terugkerende feedback en productbehoeften met Product, zorgt samen met Sales voor een soepele overdracht en helpt Marketing met inzichten die relevant zijn voor bestaande klanten.

Hoe succes eruitziet in je eerste 6 maanden

Klanten zijn snel én succesvol live. Binnen drie maanden gebruiken ze de belangrijkste onderdelen van Shiftbase, zijn hun teams aan de slag en hebben ze nog maar beperkte ondersteuning nodig.
Je klantportefeuille is gezond. Je signaleert risico's vroeg, grijpt proactief in en voorkomt dat churn pas tijdens een verlengingsgesprek aan het licht komt.
Klantsignalen krijgen snel opvolging. Je handelt verzoeken en signalen binnen de afgesproken reactietijden af en zorgt dat niets tussen wal en schip valt.
Uitbreidingskansen worden benut. Je voert door je hele portefeuille waardevolle gesprekken over add-ons en weet commerciële kansen daadwerkelijk verder te brengen.
Je draait zelfstandig onboardings. Je begeleidt implementaties en trainingen met vertrouwen en hebt daarbij nog maar weinig ondersteuning van ervaren collega's nodig.

Wie we zoeken

Je hebt ervaring met klantrelaties binnen een SaaS- of softwarebedrijf. Je weet hoe je klanten succesvol live brengt én hoe je ervoor zorgt dat ze daarna succesvol blijven. Daarnaast vinden we het belangrijk dat je:

Goed kunt prioriteren. Je ziet snel welke klanten vandaag jouw aandacht nodig hebben en welke prima zelfstandig verder kunnen.
Commercieel sterk bent zonder opdringerig te zijn. Je praat met vertrouwen over prijs, gaat soepel om met bezwaren en weet commerciële kansen op een natuurlijke manier te benutten.
Eigenaarschap neemt. Je rondt zaken af, bewaakt de opvolging en laat risico's of gemiste overdrachten niet liggen.
Technisch én commercieel kunt schakelen. Je helpt klanten met de inrichting van het platform, geeft trainingen en voert net zo gemakkelijk een gesprek met een beslisser over de volgende stap.
Nieuwsgierig bent naar de wereld van de klant. Je wilt begrijpen hoe organisaties met diensten werken en hoe planners, operationeel managers en salarisadministrateurs hun werk doen.
Je hebt een professionele beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. En daarnaast spreek je een goed woordje engels.

Wat we bieden

Hybride werken vanuit Amsterdam/Zoetermeer.
Pensioenbijdrage.
Dagelijks verse lunch op kantoor.
Bootcamp sessies op de donderdag.
Laptop naar keuze.

jobs.title: Customer Success Consultant – Vastgoed
jobs.description:
Customer Success Consultant – Vastgoed

Help vastgoedorganisaties hun duurzaamheidsambities om te zetten in concrete keuzes en resultaten.

Over Renor

Renor helpt vastgoedorganisaties om hun gebouwen toekomstbestendig en duurzamer te maken. We combineren onze eigen software, de Routekaartmanager (RKM), met inhoudelijk advies over verduurzaming en vastgoedsturing.

Met de Routekaartmanager helpen we gemeenten, onderwijsinstellingen en commerciële vastgoedorganisaties om grip te krijgen op hun duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen, investeringen en vastgoedprestaties. Van het bepalen welke gebouwen wanneer worden verduurzaamd tot het volgen van energieprestaties en de voortgang van maatregelen.

Renor groeit snel. Steeds meer organisaties werken met onze software en dienstverlening. Daarom zoeken we iemand die ervoor zorgt dat onze oplossingen ook écht goed landen bij onze klanten.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Customer Success Consultant ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor een aantal van onze klanten. Je begeleidt hen bij de implementatie en het gebruik van de Routekaartmanager en helpt om verduurzaming structureel onderdeel te maken van hun vastgoedprocessen.

Daarbij gaat het om meer dan software alleen. Je begrijpt wat een klant wil bereiken, denkt mee over de inrichting van processen en helpt om data en analyses te vertalen naar concrete keuzes. Waar nodig voer je zelf inhoudelijke advieswerkzaamheden uit, bijvoorbeeld bij het opstellen van duurzaamheidsrapportages, routekaarten en uitvoeringsplannen.

Je werkt veel samen met onze technisch adviseurs. Zij richten zich onder andere op het onboarden van vastgoeddata en het bewaken van correcte technische doorrekeningen. Jij houdt het overzicht over de klant, zorgt dat de juiste mensen betrokken zijn en helpt de organisatie om daadwerkelijk met de resultaten aan de slag te gaan.

In de praktijk betekent dat dat je:
zelfstandig een aantal klanten begeleidt en verantwoordelijk bent voor een succesvolle samenwerking en het gebruik van onze oplossingen;
klanten helpt onze software en aanpak goed te implementeren en verduurzaming te verankeren in hun vastgoedprocessen;
klantgesprekken en werksessies leidt en signaleert waar klanten meer uit onze software of dienstverlening kunnen halen;
analyses vertaalt naar concrete adviezen en meewerkt aan duurzaamheidsrapportages, routekaarten en uitvoeringsplannen;
nauw samenwerkt met technisch en strategisch adviseurs om klanten inhoudelijk én organisatorisch verder te helpen.

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken iemand die graag op het snijvlak van klant, duurzaamheid en software werkt. Je krijgt energie van klantcontact en vindt het leuk om te begrijpen hoe een organisatie werkt en wat nodig is om verduurzaming daar daadwerkelijk verder te brengen. Tegelijkertijd ben je analytisch en inhoudelijk sterk genoeg om vastgoed- en duurzaamheidsvraagstukken te doorgronden.

We denken aan iemand met:
Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;
ongeveer 3–6 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in consultancy, customer success, implementatie, vastgoed of duurzaamheid;
ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van klanten of projecten;
affiniteit met vastgoed en verduurzaming en de interesse om je hierin inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen;
een analytische en gestructureerde manier van werken en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden.

Ervaring met vastgoed en duurzaamheid is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Belangrijker is dat je snel nieuwe inhoud oppakt, goed luistert en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het succes van je klanten.

Waarom Renor?

Je stapt in bij een snelgroeiende scale-up waar software, vastgoed en duurzaamheid samenkomen. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid over je eigen klanten en werkt nauw samen met onze adviseurs, technisch adviseurs, developers en founders.

Omdat we een klein team zijn, krijg je veel mee van wat er binnen Renor gebeurt en kun je ook echt invloed hebben. Wat je bij klanten leert, gebruiken we bijvoorbeeld om onze dienstverlening én software verder te verbeteren.

We werken vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam. We lunchen samen, organiseren iedere maand een gezellige borrel en er is ruimte om een deel van de week vanuit huis te werken.

Wat bieden we?

Een salaris van €4.000 – €5.250 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring;
32–40 uur per week;
Veel verantwoordelijkheid over je eigen klanten en ruimte om je rol verder uit te bouwen;
Een goede pensioenregeling;
Laptop, telefoon en NS Business Card / reiskostenvergoeding.

Wil jij klantbegeleiding en software combineren met een inhoudelijk én maatschappelijk relevant vraagstuk? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

We werven voor deze vacature zelf; acquisitie door werving- en selectiebureaus is niet nodig.

Today, Rohlik Group serves 850,000+ customers across Europe using this technology. We have proven it works at scale. Now we are bringing it to the world. You will have real ownership over your function, direct access to the CEO, and equity in a company at the beginning of a major growth curve.

About the role

As a Customer Success Manager, you help our DACH customers realize measurable value from Spacewell’s Workplace, Energy, Asset, and Maintenance solutions. You act as a strategic partner for a portfolio of B2B customers, guiding them from onboarding and adoption to value realization, renewal, and expansion across the full Spacewell portfolio.

Using the Winning by Design SPICED framework (Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, Decision), you translate customer insights into structured success plans and concrete business outcomes that make buildings smarter, more sustainable, and more efficient.

What you will do

You will be responsible for the full customer lifecycle of your accounts, with a strong focus on onboarding, value, retention, and expansion.
Lead and coordinate onboarding and implementation for new customers, defining clear success plans with objectives, milestones, and adoption targets.
Act as the primary point of contact for your customer portfolio, building strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
Facilitate structured Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) using the SPICED framework: review delivered value, quantify Impact, identify Critical events (renewals, audits, ESG deadlines), and align on next Decisions and actions.
Monitor product usage, health scores, and engagement metrics; proactively identify risks, define remediation plans, and coordinate with Support, Professional Services, Product, and Sales.
Translate customer goals and operational data into clear business value for operational leaders, finance stakeholders, and C‑level executives.
Identify and qualify upsell and cross‑sell opportunities (additional modules, sites, services) in collaboration with Sales, always linking them to measurable outcomes for the customer.
Maintain accurate and structured account data in CRM and Customer Success tools, including SPICED fields, health metrics, forecasting data, and risk indicators.
Prepare and present structured reports and account reviews summarizing customer health, adoption progress, risks, renewal outlook, and expansion potential.
Capture and structure product feedback and customer insights, and share them with Product and Marketing to influence roadmap and go‑to‑market improvements.

Who you are

You are a customer‑centric, data‑driven relationship builder who enjoys working at the intersection of technology, business value, and long‑term partnerships.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
2–4 years of experience in Customer Success or account management in a B2B SaaS environment.
Experience in PropTech, facility management, energy management, or building operations is a strong plus.
Proven track record in driving retention and expansion (e.g. reducing churn, increasing adoption, or growing ARR within existing accounts).
Familiarity with, or strong interest in, the SPICED framework and other modern customer‑centric methodologies.
Comfortable working with CRM and Customer Success tools, including health scores and structured account data.
Strong business acumen and the ability to engage with operational, financial, and executive stakeholders.

You also bring the following competences:

Customer‑centric mindset: you focus on understanding customer goals, challenges, and impact metrics to ensure long‑term value realization.
Strategic and consultative approach: you connect customer objectives with broader business value and translate data, dashboards, and workflows into clear recommendations.
Strong relationship management: you build and maintain trusted partnerships across different organizational levels.
Analytical and commercial skills: you interpret usage and financial indicators, identify risks and growth opportunities, and recognize expansion potential in a value‑driven way.
Excellent communication: you communicate clearly in German and English and feel confident facilitating workshops and QBRs.
Collaboration & ownership: you work cross‑functionally with Sales, Product, Support, and Professional Services and take proactive ownership with a can‑do attitude.

Why join Spacewell

At Spacewell, you will join an international and innovative team that is shaping the future of smart buildings. Our platform connects workplace management, energy optimization, asset management, and maintenance to help organizations create smarter, more sustainable buildings.

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, Civil Government, you will be responsible for managing and expanding relationships with a diverse range of public sector entities across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This includes national/central governments, regional authorities, local municipalities, and key supranational organizations (e.g., Space agencies, Union bodies, and UN programmes).

You will help customers maximize the value of Planet’s imagery and geospatial solutions, ensuring that they can effectively integrate Planet data into their workflows for critical applications such as environmental monitoring, emergency response, land management, maritime surveillance, and sustainable development.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with government entities, have a solid ability to navigate highly complex and varied government structures and decision-making processes, procurement cycles, and the ability to integrate relationships across different countries and cultures. The ability to identify and build connections between ministries, directorates, and stakeholders will be key to driving adoption and impact across government initiatives.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our London, Berlin, or Haarlem office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own

Take full accountability for gross and net retention metrics across your book of business, ensuring long-term customer health and growth.
Partner closely with Account Executives to build unified strategies by bringing actionable account insights and forward-looking recommendations to internal syncs.
Map out long-term account trajectories proactively to identify capacity gaps, risks, and expansion opportunities early.

Experience working closely with sales organizations and a firm grasp of commercial business models. Able to act as a true consultative partner who can navigate trade-offs and ensure customer requests align with strategic and financial goals.
Ability to read the room, pick up on what a customer is not saying, and adjust your tone, depth, and brevity depending on whether you are speaking with a technical lead or an executive.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Russian and English.

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Start here. Grow here.

AECOM are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our Development Planning and Management Team in the South East, based in either our London, St Albans, Birmingham or Bristol office, to primarily to work on a Spatial Planning Contract for a key strategic client. The role would be providing development management advice to this client to assist them in protecting the operation, safety and future performance of the Strategic Road Network.

The candidate will act as a key team member reviewing relevant planning application documentation associated with development proposals affecting the Strategic Road Network (SRN). The role will include involvement in a range of planning consultations, undertaking high quality technical reviews of transport assessments and associated documents, mentoring junior staff and drawing on technical team’s expertise and building and maintaining client relationships.

Here’s what you’ll bring:

Client and Stakeholder Engagement
: Build and maintain strong relationships with the client team through taking ownership of reviews and associated tasks, strong communication and organisational skills. There will be the opportunity to build experience of communication and liaison with public sector stakeholders, private developers and other third parties.

Project Delivery:
Assisting the team in the overall delivery of individual tasks, meeting deadlines and managing one’s own workload and the workload of juniors, budget preparation and monitoring. You will undertake the review of transport planning documentation and ensuring the deliverables meet quality, budget, client and timeline requirements.

Technical Skills:
A good understanding of Transport Assessments and the wider planning process with the ability to critically review third party documents, interrogate calculations, assumptions and associated information and successfully convey the outcomes competently in a Technical Note. It is expected that the candidate would have experience/ understanding of the following:
Trip Generation
Trip Distribution/ Assignment
Junction Capacity Modelling (JUNCTIONS/ LINSIG and awareness of microsimulation/ strategic modelling ideally)
Mitigation suitability

In addition, awareness of related transport documentation such as DMRB compliance reviews, GG104 Safety Risk Assessments, WCHARs, Road Safety Audits/ Documentation would be beneficial. . This is an excellent opportunity to become part of one of the UK's leading multidisciplinary consultancies, working on projects that shape communities, support sustainable growth and deliver lasting positive impact.

Job Summary:

To lead, inspire and be accountable for the overall performance of SSP UK & Ireland’s existing customer base. The Customer Success Manager is the face of the customer team – a trusted, senior leader who takes full ownership of retention, growth, customer satisfaction and commercial performance across the portfolio of existing accounts. Reporting directly to the Sales and Marketing Director, this role leads a team of Account Managers and Senior Relationship Managers, setting the standard for customer obsession, trusted advisory relationships and proactive account management across all customer segments.

Job Description

Main Area of Responsibility

Leads the customer success function with full accountability for the retention, satisfaction and commercial growth of SSP UK & Ireland’s existing customer portfolio. Acts as the most senior day-to-day point of contact for the customer team, setting the tone for how customers are engaged, supported and valued across all accounts.

Serves as the primary escalation point for the team, providing guidance, support and direct intervention where customer situations require a more senior touch, including complex complaints, contractual disputes, service failures or relationship difficulties. Ensures every escalation is handled with urgency, care and a clear resolution focus, and that lessons learned are fed back into team practice.

Acts as a trusted advisor at the most senior levels where required, including C-suite and board engagement, building confidence in SSP UK & Ireland as a long-term strategic partner. Models and champions customer-obsessed behaviours across the team, ensuring regular, high-quality customer engagement is embedded as standard practice throughout the Account Manager and Senior Relationship Manager population.

Develops and maintains a clear picture of the health, risk and commercial opportunity across the entire existing customer portfolio. Uses data, customer feedback and team intelligence to identify trends, risks and opportunities, and ensures this insight is shared with relevant internal stakeholders including product teams across our P&Ls.

Ensures that customer requirements and insights gathered by the team are clearly articulated and fed through to the relevant product teams, so that SSP’s UK & Ireland product roadmaps (across all P&Ls) remain commercially relevant and customer-led.

Drives a culture of accountability within the team, ensuring account plans are in place and kept current for every customer, that Hubspot is used consistently and accurately, and that pipeline, renewal forecasts and commercial reporting are reliable and up to date.

Maintains oversight of debt management across the portfolio, ensuring the team is proactively managing outstanding balances and that issues are escalated and resolved in a timely manner. Maintains oversight of all open complaints and service issues, ensuring the team is acting with appropriate urgency and that patterns of dissatisfaction are identified and addressed.

Accountability

Report directly to the Sales and Marketing Director with full accountability for the retention, growth and satisfaction performance of the existing customer base.
Own and be accountable for the team’s financial targets, including renewal rates, revenue retention and account growth across the portfolio.
Lead, manage and develop a team of Account Managers and Senior Relationship Managers, setting clear objectives, providing regular coaching and feedback, and ensuring every team member has the support and direction needed to perform at their best.
Act as a role model for the customer-centric behaviours and relationship standards expected across the team.
Act as the primary point of escalation for the team on all customer matters – including complex complaints, service failures, contractual disputes and relationship issues that require senior intervention.
Take personal ownership of escalated situations, driving resolution with urgency and ensuring the customer’s experience remains at the forefront throughout.
Ensure every customer in the portfolio has a current, well-maintained account plan, covering relationship mapping, commercial opportunity, risk assessment and engagement cadence.
Review account plans regularly with the team and challenge where activity or ambition falls short of what is needed.
Maintain a comprehensive view of portfolio health, renewal pipelines and commercial performance. Ensure accurate and timely reporting through Hubspot, and present portfolio performance, risks and opportunities to the Sales and Marketing Director on a regular basis.
Drive the overall level of customer engagement and satisfaction across the portfolio – setting engagement standards, monitoring satisfaction metrics, and ensuring the team is consistently delivering a high-quality, responsive customer experience.
Own the measurement and continuous improvement of customer satisfaction across all segments.
Take accountability for debt management across the full portfolio, ensuring the team maintains proactive oversight and that outstanding balances are resolved in a timely manner. Escalate and manage directly where required.
Collaborate closely with product teams across the P&Ls, ensuring that customer insights gathered through the team’s engagement activity are fed through effectively and that customers feel heard in SSP’s UK & Ireland product and roadmap decisions.
Work cross-functionally with professional services, customer support, finance and other internal teams to ensure a joined-up and excellent customer experience.

Join BBC Studios Digital as a Planning Coordinator, providing planning, analytical, presentation and coordination support to the Digital Planning team within Brands & Licensing. You'll help deliver annual and long-range planning, portfolio strategy, reporting and cross-functional initiatives for key brands such as Bluey and Top Gear, helping turning data, research and business context into clear strategic planning materials.

Build your career in a small, cross-functional planning team at the heart of BBC Studios Digital. Conduct desk research on market, platform and competitor developments, summarising relevant insights and implications for the Digital Division.
Consolidate data from multiple sources and use Excel to support revenue and performance reporting, prepare summaries and simple analysis, and maintain accurate planning and reporting information.
Act as a key point of coordination across editorial, commercial and other teams, building strong relationships with stakeholders at different levels and helping improve planning processes, templates and ways of working.

Essential Criteria

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear, polished presentations that communicate data, plans and strategy effectively.
Excel skills and confidence working with data, including the ability to organise, manipulate, interpret and present information clearly.
Experience or demonstrable interest in digital media, content, entertainment, platforms or other consumer-facing businesses.
Experience supporting business planning, strategy, project coordination or operational activity, including through employment, internships, placements or relevant university/project work.
Experience producing reports, presentations or business documentation and turning quantitative and qualitative information into concise summaries.

Desired But Not Required

Curiosity about the business and strategy side of digital media, entertainment, platforms and audience behaviour, with confidence in carrying out research and competitor reviews.
Excellent organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities; proactive, comfortable using initiative and able to solve problems independently.
Familiarity with portfolio planning, go-to-market planning, commercial strategy or digital product/platform strategy.
Usage of digital tools to support research, analysis or presentation development.

If you can bring some of these skills and experience, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply.

We appreciate your interest in this position and understand how important this opportunity is to you. Our Heathrow Expansion programme offers a unique and exciting opportunity to play a defining role in one of the UK’s most significant infrastructure projects.  

You’ll help shape a national legacy that millions will experience for decades to come, as we deliver the third runway, improve passenger experience, stimulate jobs and opportunities across the UK, and strengthen the global connectivity that powers trade and travel.

Modernising and expanding the UK’s only hub airport and critical national infrastructure whilst keeping it fully operational and safe, creates a pace and complexity unlike other major programmes.  It demands collaboration, resilience, problem solving and a desire to take on challenges that genuinely matter.  

From securing planning consents to designing a new runway, modernising terminals and improving public transport access, and delivering on environmental and community commitments - the scale is unmatched.  

You’ll be part of a diverse team of talented colleagues, built on mutual respect and where excellence thrives.  It’s an inspiring place to work, with unlimited opportunities to make a difference as you help to shape the future of our world-class airport.

Job Description

Reporting to the Head of Town Planning and Consenting, the Town Planning Manager plays a key role in shaping Heathrow’s sustainable future by developing and implementing planning and consenting strategies that support the airport’s long-term growth and investment ambitions. The role is responsible for helping secure the planning consents required to deliver Heathrow’s capital investment programmes, working across a diverse portfolio of infrastructure and development projects. Drawing on expertise in both the Town and Country Planning Act (TCPA) and Development Consent Order (DCO) regimes, you will provide strategic planning guidance that enables successful project delivery while balancing operational, environmental and community considerations.

This is an opportunity to influence some of the UK’s most significant aviation and infrastructure developments. You will provide trusted advice on national, regional and local planning policy, helping to shape and influence emerging policy frameworks, including matters relating to the Airports National Policy Statement, to protect and promote Heathrow’s interests. Success in the role requires strong stakeholder engagement skills, commercial awareness and the ability to navigate complex planning challenges with confidence and credibility. As a visible and collaborative presence at Heathrow’s Compass Centre, you will build strong relationships across the business, with external partners and key decision-makers, ensuring planning considerations are effectively integrated into strategic and operational decision-making.

Your role will involve

Provide strategic planning advice to the business on planning policy, the Airports National Policy Statement (ANPS), and the progression of major capital investment projects through the planning system.
Build and maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders, including local planning authorities, the Planning Inspectorate, statutory consultees, and external agencies, to support successful project delivery.
Lead the preparation, submission, and management of planning applications, Development Consent Order (DCO) activities, and other consenting requirements, ensuring alignment with Heathrow’s capital investment and growth objectives.
Develop and implement consenting strategies, including pre-application engagement, regulatory approvals, and planning submissions, while providing proactive advice on planning and development matters.
Monitor planning policy, legislative changes, and third-party developments, ensuring compliance with planning obligations and conditions, and delivering robust responses that protect and promote Heathrow’s interests.

These Skills Are Essential

Chartered Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute or working towards Chartered Membership
Relevant DCO experience of developing infrastructure in a planning and consenting role
Excellent knowledge of UK planning law and regulation as well as policies and procedures
Significant planning experience within an established UK Planning team
Significant experience in handling Planning, Environmental Impact Assessment, Compulsory Acquisition and Statutory Consultation matters related to large infrastructure projects
Interpersonal skills to build and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders

Ideally, you will also have

Planning, aviation or related post graduate qualifications
Knowledge in Airspace Change Process
Interest in public policy and political affairs

About Us

There’s something so special about working at the world’s most iconic airport. Its sights. Its sounds. Its constant air of excitement. Heathrow is an amazing backdrop to a career filled with unique opportunities.

Every day, you’ll discover a world full of fresh possibilities and end the day buzzing with stories to tell, as you encounter people from all cultures, nationalities and experiences. A world full of pride for what we do and no end of exciting career prospects to explore.

It brings out the best in all of us. And inspires everyone to deliver on our ambitious plans. Together, we’re working to welcome millions more passengers while ensuring aviation can continue to be a force for good by leading global efforts in sustainability.

Join us on that journey and we'll help you achieve your ambitions too. Supporting you to learn, encouraging you to be yourself, backing you to achieve more than you might ever have imagined. Because there’s no place like Heathrow.

Our rewards

We offer competitive salaries and excellent benefits that will support you now and in the future. As well as performance-based annual bonuses and our longer-term Share in Success Bonus plans, we also offer generous annual leave allowances and market-leading pensions. With family friendly policies, access to private health insurance and a wide range of wellbeing tools, we’ll support you to be at your best inside and outside work. And of course, we’ll provide varied learning and development opportunities too. Here you’ll find everything you need for a fulfilling career journey that can take you in exciting directions.

Working Location

Our Hybrid working approach offers the opportunity for colleagues in some roles to work from home for an average of two days a week, providing the flexibility to work in an agile way whilst ensuring we deliver for the operational needs of Heathrow . Working arrangements vary from team to team and will be confirmed during the recruitment process. You’ll need to be based in the UK and within a commutable distance to Heathrow.

Sustainable Travel to work

Heathrow’s Sustainable Travel Guide sets out easy and sustainable travel options that everyone can access.

Equal Opportunities

As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage applications from all. We believe that diverse talent makes us stronger – not least because we welcome passengers from all corners of the globe, every single day. Heathrow is an accessible place to work. With five diversity networks, we champion inclusivity and celebrate individuality.

jobs.title: Junior Planner Kustwacht
jobs.description:
Vacature kenmerken

Standplaats: Den Helder

Contractduur: 2 jaar

Uren per week: - 38

Maandsalaris: €2.976,00 - €3.924,00

Salarisniveau: Burgerschaal IBBAD 06 - Burgerschaal IBBAD 06

Niveau: MBO 3

Vakgebied: Verkeer / nautisch; Documentatie en Informatievoorziening; Personeel en organisatie

Vacaturenummer: 79688

Dienstverband: Tijdelijke aanstelling met zicht op vaste aanstelling

Functiegroep: Burger

Functieomschrijving

Een meldkamer die 24 uur per dag klaarstaat en collega’s die dag en nacht bijdragen aan de veiligheid op zee. Dat vraagt om systemen waarop we kunnen vertrouwen en een personele planning die klopt. Precies daar kom jij in beeld.

Als Junior Planner bij de Kustwacht zorg jij dat de juiste mensen op het juiste moment beschikbaar zijn. Je maakt en beheert de roosters voor het Maritiem Operatie Centrum (MOC). Je houdt zicht op de bezetting en verwerkt verlof en andere wijzigingen. Verandert er iets? Dan puzzel jij verder tot de planning weer klopt.

Je werkt daarbij samen met collega’s van de Kustwacht en onze partnerorganisaties. Je houdt verschillende belangen in het oog en signaleert knelpunten op tijd. Zijn er niet genoeg collega’s beschikbaar? Dan onderzoek je wat wél mogelijk is. Je maakt een voorstel en bespreekt dit met je leidinggevende.

Ook kijk je verder dan de planning van vandaag. Je houdt gegevens bij en levert informatie voor rapportages. Zie je dat iets slimmer kan? Dan horen we dat graag. Met jouw ideeën help je onze manier van plannen te verbeteren.

Je dagelijkse werk bestaat uit:

Personeelsroosters maken, beheren en aanpassen;
De beschikbaarheid van collega’s bijhouden;
Adviseren over de inzet van beschikbare collega’s;
Aanvragen, wijzigingen en verlof verwerken;
Planningen afstemmen met onze partnerorganisaties;
Knelpunten signaleren en oplossingen voorstellen;
Gegevens bijhouden voor administratie en rapportages;
Meedenken over verbeteringen in onze planning.

Functie-eisen

Je hoeft nog geen jarenlange ervaring als planner te hebben. Belangrijker is dat je graag organiseert, nauwkeurig werkt en overzicht houdt. Ook als de planning onverwacht verandert. Jij ziet werk liggen, neemt initiatief en zorgt dat alles goed geregeld is.

Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde mbo-3 opleiding.
Je hebt enige ervaring met personeelsplanning.
Je hebt affiniteit met plannen en roosteren.
Je werkt makkelijk met verschillende IT-systemen. Ervaring met Excel is mooi meegenomen.
Je werkt goed samen en communiceert duidelijk.
Je kunt een Verklaring van Geen Bezwaar (VGB-B) verkrijgen.

Competenties

Defensie - Samenwerken

Defensie - Resultaatgericht

Defensie - Plannen en organiseren

Defensie - Communiceren

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Salarisniveau: Burgerschaal IBBAD 06 - Burgerschaal IBBAD 06

Salarisomschrijving: Het salaris is gebaseerd op een 38-urige werkweek.

Maandsalaris: €2.976,00 - €3.924,00

Dienstverband: Tijdelijke aanstelling met zicht op vaste aanstelling

Contractduur: 2 jaar

Maximaal aantal uren per week: 38

Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden

Naast het salaris ontvang je een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,33% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in extra vakantie-uren of besteden aan fiscaal vriendelijke doelen, zoals een (elektrische) fiets of laptop. Het is ook nog mogelijk je werktijd (tijdelijk) enkele uren per week te verkorten.

Wij vinden het ook belangrijk dat je het werken bij Defensie met jouw privéleven kunt combineren. Diverse verlofregelingen (bijvoorbeeld 75% betaald ouderschapsverlof) en aandacht voor fysieke en mentale gezondheid dragen bij aan een goede balans. Zo kun je onder andere gratis gebruik maken van onze uitgebreide sportfaciliteiten. Naast een pensioenregeling bij het ABP ontvang je maandelijks een vergoeding woon-werkverkeer of kun je onder gunstige voorwaarden kiezen voor een OV-abonnement met onbeperkt reizen door heel Nederland.

Bijzonderheden

De functie staat open ter uitbreiding van het team. Er is ruimte voor 1 vte.
Zet voor de zekerheid alvast de volgende data in je agenda, want de sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op 7 oktober 2026.
Een online screening en referentiecheck kunnen onderdeel zijn van de selectieprocedure.
Werken bij de Kustwacht betekent dat je bij crisissituaties een rol kunt vervullen in het Operationeel Team (OT). Piketdiensten maken hier onderdeel van uit. Daarom is het belangrijk dat je op redelijke afstand van het Kustwachtcentrum in Den Helder woont. Een reistijd van ongeveer één uur geldt als maximale richtlijn.
Elke nieuwe medewerker start met de basisopleiding. Daarna volg je een gerichte opleiding die je voorbereidt op jouw specifieke rol binnen het crisisteam. De duur en inhoud hiervan zijn afhankelijk van de organisatiebehoefte en je functie.
Goed om te weten: bij gelijke geschiktheid hebben interne kandidaten voorrang.
Voordat je bij ons in dienst komt vindt er een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) plaats.
Werk je bij een bureau en wil je een kandidaat voorstellen voor deze vacature bij de Kustwacht? Bedankt, maar hier gaan we niet op in. We werven onze nieuwe collega graag zelf.

Eerst oriënteren? Dat kan altijd.

Twijfel je of deze functie bij je past? Of wil je eerst meer weten over het werk, de opleiding of de bereikbaarheid? Neem gerust contact met ons op. We beantwoorden je vragen en denken graag met je mee. Mail ons via: werkenbij@kustwacht.nl

Ook als je nog niet zeker weet of je wil solliciteren, ben je welkom om je te oriënteren. Soms begint een nieuwe stap gewoon met één vraag.

Organisatienaam

Kustwacht Nederland

Organisatieomschrijving

Wij zijn de Kustwacht. We zorgen dag en nacht voor een veilig en verantwoord gebruik van de Noordzee en de ruime binnenwateren. Dat doen we door mensen in nood te redden, toezicht te houden, regels te handhaven en strafbare activiteiten op te sporen. Vanuit het Maritiem Operatie Centrum (MOC) in Den Helder coördineren we deze taken. Dat doen we samen met partners zoals de KNRM, Douane en Politie.

De Noordzee wordt steeds drukker. Jouw werk draagt niet alleen bij aan de veiligheid van vandaag, maar je bouwt ook mee aan de maritieme wereld van morgen. Daarbij laten we ons leiden door onze kernwaarden: verbondenheid, durf, vertrouwen en vakmanschap.

Als Junior Planner werk je bij de Kustwacht, onderdeel van het Ministerie van Defensie. Je komt als burger in dienst bij Defensie en werkt onder de vlag van de Kustwacht. Je werklocatie is Den Helder. In overleg met je leidinggevende is hybride werken mogelijk.

Organisatie-URL

www.kustwacht.nl

Afdeling-URL

www.defensie.nl

Afdelingsnaam

afdeling Planning en Verantwoording

Afdelingsomschrijving

De juiste mensen en eenheden op het juiste moment beschikbaar. Daar zorgt de afdeling Planning en Verantwoording voor. We stemmen de personeelsplanning af op de vlucht- en vaarroutes. Zo ontstaat één planning waarin mensen, schepen, helikopters en vliegtuigen goed op elkaar aansluiten. De afdeling kijkt ook terug op de inzet. We brengen in kaart hoe onze eenheden zijn ingezet en wat daarmee is bereikt. Zo maken we inzichtelijk hoe de Kustwacht de middelen van zes ministeries gebruikt om onze taken uit te voeren.

Als Junior Planner richt jij je vooral op de personeelsplanning. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s die onze vliegende en varende eenheden plannen.

Kom jij ons team versterken? Dan laten we jou natuurlijk niet zwemmen. Je start met onze basisopleiding. Zo leer je de Kustwacht, ons werk en het maritieme werkveld goed kennen. Je leert bijvoorbeeld hoe we zoeken naar vermiste personen en bezoekt verschillende partnerorganisaties. Daarna ben je goed voorbereid om binnen jouw eigen functie aan de slag te gaan. Ook daarna blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen. We bieden regelmatig bijscholing, trainingen, cursussen en vervolgopleidingen aan om iedereen up-to-date te houden met de laatste ontwikkelingen.

Contactpersonen

Voor meer informatie over deze vacature:

werkenbij@kustwacht.nl

Voor meer informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure:

Team P&O Advies

About The Division

Environmental and social considerations are central to Mott MacDonald’s Purpose and its offerings across all sectors and territories. Our environment and social business provides essential services and innovative solutions which anticipate our clients' needs across all sectors.

Overview Of The Role

We are seeking an enthusiastic Senior Town Planner, who is up for the challenge of infrastructure delivery to join our expanding town planning team. You will be based in either Cardiff or Bristol supporting us in the delivery of a range of major infrastructure projects. We need a driven individual to support and grow our capabilities in providing strategic advice and securing planning approvals and consents across a range of sectors, including rail, defence, energy generation, energy and water infrastructure, climate resilience, education, health, housing, employment, mixed-use regeneration and waste focused schemes.

You will be responsible for supporting and helping to drive the growth of our offer in Wales and the SW of England, developing relationships with colleagues across the business, you will have a particular focus on forging links and growing opportunities within your region. You will be working alongside the full range of technical disciplines Mott MacDonald offers on some of the largest, most complex, challenging and exciting infrastructure and development projects in the UK. These will cover multiple sectors including energy, water, transport and the built and natural environment, for clients including Network Rail, Transport for Wales (TfW), Associated British Ports, Welsh Water, Wessex Water, South West Water, National Highways, National Grid, Environment Agency, NHS, Government Departments such as the Department for Education (DfE) and a range of local authorities.

Key responsibilities and duties include:
Working as part of the planning team to deliver a range of planning projects, including working alongside and potentially project managing and leading other disciplines as part of a multi-disciplinary delivery team
Writing and reviewing planning deliverables to a very high standard. Leading and co-ordinating the preparation of planning applications, including managing the inputs from more junior members of staff, colleagues from across the business and sub-consultants

Preparing inputs and potentially leading bids for new work
Supporting more junior members of staff in their chartership and professional development
Supporting the growth of the Wales and SW England Planning team in respect of developing the team within the region, liaising with current and potential clients for the business and raising the profile of the planning team both internally and externally across the region

Degree and/or Masters in Town Planning
Extensive town planning experience
Chartered Member of the RTPI
Experience of preparing and submitting planning applications, drafting reports, feasibility studies, masterplans and regeneration strategies
Experience of working with a range of client bodies including both private sector and public sector
Previous experience of, and having an active role in the delivery of varied infrastructure, regeneration and environmental projects
Experience in overseeing, and/or project managing multidisciplinary projects
Experience of supporting and mentoring more junior members of the team
Experience of team working to support the delivery of projects
Experience of financial accountability for projects and delivery of projects within budget

jobs.title: Customer Success Executive
jobs.description:
Customer Success Executive

Remote | UK-Based | Full-Time
£28,800-£38,000
depending on experience, skills and qualifications

About InTouch

Our customers are growing law firms - the kind where the processes that worked for a handful of matters a month start to strain as the caseload climbs. Their clients expect to be kept informed, their regulators expect every step to be consistent and auditable, and their partners want to take on more work without being buried in admin. InTouch is the case management platform built for them: it closes more matters with less management overhead, builds compliance and consistency into every workflow, keeps clients updated automatically, and connects everything from accounts to the client portal. We have served firms like these across six countries since 2015, and we onboard every one with a real person.

We are a small, ambitious team of under 10 people. This role exists because that real person matters more as we grow.

The Role

You will report to our Head of Customer Relations and will be the person law firms talk to once they have signed up: helping them get InTouch set up, answering their questions, and making sure they keep getting value from the platform over time. You own the execution that makes customers successful day to day.

Your job is to help law firms get the most out of InTouch.

How the Work Actually Happens

Most of your communication will be by email. Law firms are busy and most questions are best handled in writing - clearly, professionally, and with the right level of detail.

There will be phone and video calls too, but not constantly. Onboarding new firms involves scheduled video calls, and occasional client check-ins happen by phone or video. You will not be on the phone all day. You will grow into more call-based work as you become more confident with the platform and the customer base - onboarding leads naturally to that.

What You Will Do

Customer support and questions

Respond to client queries clearly and professionally, mostly by email. Troubleshoot what you can, and escalate cleanly to our development team when you cannot - with structured context, not just a forwarded email.

Onboarding new firms

Help new customers get set up on InTouch - account configuration, workflow setup, templates - and walk them through the platform so they can use it confidently from day one. Most onboarding happens over video and email, but some is done in person at the firm's offices - the larger the firm, the more likely you will be there face to face, while smaller firms are usually handled remotely. In practice that means occasional travel, typically once or twice a month.

Customer health and proactive follow-up

We track how firms are using InTouch. When a firm looks like they are underusing the platform or missing key features, you will reach out to help them get more value from what they are already paying for.

Product feedback and testing

Test new features before release. Tell us what is confusing, what is broken, and what customers will actually use. Log clear, structured feedback to the product team.

Help guides and knowledge content

Spot the questions that come up repeatedly and turn them into help articles, guides and support content so customers can self-serve where they want to.

Internal SOPs

As we grow, document the processes you find yourself doing. Help us build a customer support function that scales.

What Success Looks Like
By month 3: you can confidently answer the majority of inbound customer questions without escalation, and you have onboarded at least one new firm independently.

By month 6: customers are mentioning you by name in their feedback, our help content has grown, and our average response time has improved.

By month 12: you have helped shape how customer success works at InTouch, not just executed it - and you are trusted to run the day-to-day without anyone looking over your shoulder.

Who We Are Looking For

You write clearly and professionally.
Most of your job is written communication with lawyers, who are precise readers - your emails need to be clear, structured and unambiguous.

You are organised, calm and thorough, and you close loops reliably and punctually.
Customers dealing with a problem need to feel they are in safe hands and that nothing will fall through the cracks - and the best people in this role are the ones who never need reminding that something is still open.

You take ownership without being asked.
You manage your own queue, decide what needs attention, and chase the answer yourself rather than waiting for someone to tell you what to do next. In a small remote team, that is the difference between someone who helps and someone who has to be managed.

You are comfortable learning new software quickly.
You will need to know InTouch deeply - we will teach you, but you will need to absorb it fast.

You are technically savvy.
Customer set ups range from creating simple task lists to bespoke online forms and document templates. You will have direct ownership of these projects and need to build these items so that they work in the best way possible for the client. You are comfortable using AI and can clearly explain it.

You are confident leading meetings and delivering training.
You will need to guide users through the system clearly and efficiently, helping them get to grips with their account as quickly as possible. Your communication is effective, collegiate and authoritative.

You enjoy improving processes, not just following them.
As a small company, the way we work today is not how we will work in two years, and you can help shape that by asking questions, identifying improvements and offering solutions

Experience in SaaS, legal tech or professional services is desirable, as is a customer success, onboarding, implementation or support background.
Written communication, genuine ownership and the ability to learn fast matter more to us than a perfect CV. Educational achievement is an indicator of intellectual capability, but we value real-world trajectory and experience. If your exam results don’t tell the whole story your extracurricular achievements, career trajectory and drive to succeed should.  

What We Offer

Fully remote, UK-based
£28,800-£38,000
23 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Your birthday off, or the closest working day
3 additional days of annual leave for each year of service, up to 15 extra days (39 days plus bank holidays after 5 years)
A small, collaborative team where your work is visible and your judgement is trusted

Why Join InTouch?

Our customers genuinely rely on us, and they tell us so. You would be the person they turn to - the one who gets them set up well and keeps them getting value - in a company small enough that the quality of that relationship is visible to everyone.

We are not filling a seat. We are looking for someone who wants to be part of a small company that takes its customers seriously, uses technology thoughtfully, and gives people room to do good work.

How to Apply

Apply online at https://www.intouch.cloud/join-us

About The Role

Insite are seeking a Compliance Analyst to support the provision of compliance services to Insite’s heat network clients regarding Ofgem’s consumer protection regulations (Heat Network (Market Framework) (Great Britain) Regulations 2025).

The Compliance Analyst will play a critical role in supporting Insite Energy’s clients to meet upcoming regulatory requirements for heat network heat suppliers and operators. As a member of the Compliance team, they will ensure Insite clients are fully prepared for or working towards the standards and conditions required under Ofgem regulation.

This role involves liaising with internal departments and external client representatives to research and validate data, documents and processes, maintaining the research findings within a dedicated system tracking the required activity against each regulatory requirement.

Key outputs from the compliance system are reports tracking a heat supplier or specific networks’ journey towards compliance, and when achieved to maintain it. The Compliance Analyst may also be the person responsible for completing submissions to government bodies on behalf of some clients.

The analyst will serve as an advisor to Insite’s internal departments, such as Client Experience, Customer Experience, Operations and the wider business, supporting the delivery of fully compliant client-facing activities, solutions, and operational practices.

The role holder will project manage activities for each client to achieve regulatory compliance.

Location and working hours:

Full-time position (37.5 hours per week).
Office location: Stuart House, Peterborough (PE1 5DD) with flexibility to work from home as agreed with line manager.

Essential Skills And Qualifications

University degree in a Business field, Law or Legal Studies, Compliance, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Experience in managing or supporting multiple project-based activities simultaneously and high-volume task management prioritisation
Highly IT capable across multiple common systems e.g. Office 365 applications with good written and verbal skills.
Demonstrated experience working with both internal and external stakeholders
Strong attention to detail.

Desirable Skills And Qualifications

Project Management experience and/or qualification (or desire to progress one)
Experience in or knowledge of utility service sector business (or a relevant regulated industry, heat network experience/knowledge is a bonus)
Familiarity with regulatory audits, accreditation schemes, or certification processes

Benefits

Salary: Up to £37,500 per annum, depending on knowledge, skills and experience.
Holiday Allowance: 26 days of holiday per year (including birthday leave) plus English bank and public holidays, plus an additional day of Birthday leave.
Pension Scheme: Employer pension contribution matched at 4%.

This benefits package offers a vibrant and supportive work environment, with opportunities for professional growth, work-life balance, and community engagement.

About Insite

Established in 2009, Insite Energy is a dynamic, fast-growing company that provides services to heat network suppliers in the UK. The services provided include metering & billing of residential customers, the installation (and retrofit) of credit billed and pay-as-you-go equipment, and ongoing maintenance and management of the heat network schemes.

We pride ourselves on our commitment to working as one team to put the customer and client first, delivering a reliable, competitive, and professional service. We are tireless in our efforts to be the best at what we do, which is reflected in our Trustpilot rating. With just over 120 current employees, we are small but mighty, delivering more by working together.

At Insite Energy, we embrace diversity and inclusion. We value all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We're committed to providing equal opportunities for all and offering reasonable adjustments to ensure accessibility and inclusivity throughout the application process and in the workplace.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager @ Aivory

Remote (Nederland) · veel op locatie bij praktijken · zo snel mogelijk

Aivory bouwt de modernste AI-software voor tandartspraktijken. Geen extra laagje op oude systemen, maar één platform dat agenda, dossier, behandelplan en administratie overneemt — zodat de tandarts tijd overhoudt voor de patiënt.

We groeien hard. Tientallen praktijken draaien al op Aivory. De pijplijn is vol. En er moeten er nog honderden bij. Dat lukt alleen als onboarding schaalbaar, strak én menselijk is. Daarvoor zoeken we een Customer Success Manager die ownership pakt.

Dit is geen helpdeskrol.

Je bent de persoon die een praktijk van “we stappen over” naar “we draaien” brengt. Vaak op locatie. Vaak in één dag. En daarna denk je mee hoe we dat proces nóg beter en sneller maken.

Wat je gaat doen Praktijken onboarden: je bent veel onderweg door Nederland, staat naast het team in de praktijk en zorgt dat ze confident live gaan.
Eigenaarschap nemen over de hele onboardingreis: voorbereiding, livegang, eerste weken, nazorg.
Relaties bouwen met praktijkhouders, praktijkmanagers en assistenten. Jij bent hun vaste aanspreekpunt.
Het onboardingproces zelf beter maken. Waar het wringt, los je het op. Playbooks, checklists, training, tooling, volgorde — jij denkt en bouwt mee.
Signalen uit de praktijk terugbrengen naar product, support en de rest van het team.
High agency: je wacht niet op een ticket of een overleg. Je ziet wat er moet gebeuren en je doet het.

Wie we zoeken Je hebt ervaring in snel groeiende startups. Tempo, onduidelijkheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid energize je, in plaats van dat het je afremt.
Je hebt eerder klanten geonboard. Liefst hands-on, in volume, en het liefst ook op locatie.
Ervaring in de mondzorg is een sterke pré. Geen must — wel een plus als je de taal van de praktijk al spreekt.
Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Dat is een harde eis.
Je hebt geen probleem met veel reizen naar praktijken. Remote is de basis, de praktijk is waar het werk gebeurt.
Je bent high agency. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, je communiceert direct, en je laat geen ballen vallen.

Wat we bieden Salaris: €5.000 – €7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van wat je meeneemt.
Bonus per onboarding.
Aandelen: je wordt deels eigenaar van Aivory. We zoeken iemand die dit voor de lange termijn bouwt.
MacBook Pro.
Reiskostenvergoeding. In overleg een leaseauto.
Remote werken, met veel dagen op locatie bij praktijken.
Klein team, korte lijnen, directe impact. Geen lagen, geen theater.
Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk.

Solliciteren Stuur je CV en een korte motivatie naar ties@aivory.nl
of stuur Ties Verberne een bericht via LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/tiesverberne.
Geen lange brief nodig. Vertel kort waarom jij dit wilt doen en waar je eerder klanten live hebt gezet.

With Every Community, Stantec Redefines What’s Possible.

The Opportunity

Join our 2027 Graduate Programme as a Graduate Town Planner
in our Cambridge

About The Role

As a Stantec Graduate Town Planner, you'll join a collaborative team of 25 professionals and fellow graduates, developing your expertise within a creative and interdisciplinary environment. You'll gain exposure to a wide variety of projects across the residential, commercial and environmental sectors, supporting work from initial research and site appraisals through to planning applications, community engagement, plan promotion and planning appeals.

Our Town Planning team specialises in large-scale, complex mixed-use and residential-led developments across the North West, including new communities, garden villages, regeneration projects, environmental initiatives and major infrastructure schemes.

This role offers excellent opportunities to broaden your planning knowledge, build professional skills and gain experience in multidisciplinary project delivery while being supported by experienced colleagues throughout your development.

Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications.
Supporting community engagement and stakeholder consultation activities.

Assisting with planning appeals and the preparation of supporting documentation.
Working on a diverse range of residential, commercial and environmental projects.

Description

The candidate will support the Head of Compliance, and the compliance team with the risk management framework and risk management policy implementation across Insurance Solutions businesses. Support the Compliance and Risk Manager with the implementation, maintenance and ongoing enhancement of the Insurance Solutions risk management framework, promoting consistent risk identification, assessment, ownership, monitoring and reporting across Insurance Solutions entities and business units.

Engage proactively with risk owners across Insurance Solutions to identify existing, new and emerging risks, agree risk ratings and support proportionate controls, mitigations and action plans.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Discover yourself in Lewisham where what you do makes a difference to our vibrant and culturally diverse communities!

We have a rich history of welcoming people from all over the world and are proud to be recognised as the UK’s first Borough of Sanctuary, for our work in championing the rights of refugees and migrants.

Introduction

Do you want to be involved in a varied range of contentious and high-profile planning applications that ranges from award winning developments, work contributing to our ambitious small sites programme and supporting the growth of our high streets and town centres.

Then this role is for you – join our high-performing, nationally ‘Gold Rated’ planning team.

From Lewisham Town Centre with its major shopping centre and market, Deptford’s nightlife to Blackheath's village atmosphere and the woodlands of Beckenham Place Park, Lewisham is one of London’s most diverse and rapidly evolving areas. We now have a unique opportunity for a forward-thinking town planner to use design‑led densification to help create and shape vibrant, well-designed neighbourhoods where people can truly thrive.

Our newly adopted Local Plan has a vision for the borough to 2040, and we have huge ambition for new housing growth and investment in our places.

As a planner in our area teams, you’ll responsible for processing a wide range of planning applications, providing a valuable opportunity to develop your skills and advance your career in planning. We're seeking motivated and enthusiastic candidates who are passionate about planning and ready to grow and make a difference.

What’s the role?

You will manage the full process for planning applications, pre-applications, and appeals. Working as part of a supportive team, you will be responsible for:

Exercise delegated decision-making powers.
Provide expert advice to internal and external stakeholders.
Supervise junior staff while ensuring performance standards are met.
Deputise for team leaders’ line management responsibilities as needed.
Negotiating with applicants and addressing objections on your cases.
Prepare comprehensive reports with recommendations.
Present applications to the planning committee when needed.
Prepare statements for Written Representation Appeals and lead the preparation and presentation of evidence at Public Inquiries and Hearings.
Identify and deliver service-improvement and revenue-generation projects.

What’s in it for you?

You will gain substantial experience development management across a varied complex caseload and excellent training and development, management and project-work opportunities.

Excellent training and development opportunities, plus a range of benefits including:

Generous holiday allowance
Local Government Pension scheme
Flexible working and family friendly policies
Season ticket and bicycle loans
A range of staff discounts including local subsidised gym memberships
Supportive staff networks

What We’re Looking For

You will be a town planner with relevant experience, who has an appreciation of London and national politics and have the ability to work independently, managing a range of competing demands with initiative. Strong interpersonal skills are essential, as the role involves working closely with applicants, residents, consultants and colleagues across the council.

You should bring:

Good organisational, negotiation, written and verbal communication and IT skills
Ability to prioritise and allocate work to meet deadlines.
Attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and consistency in planning recommendations and advice for various customers.
Research and analytical skills to stay informed and continually expand your planning knowledge, whilst taking account of corporate priorities.
Experience in mentoring, supervision and support of junior officers.

Location

The job is primarily based in Laurence House, Catford but we operate a hybrid approach where you will be required to work both in the office (currently Tuesdays and Wednesdays) and from home on a regular basis.

Special conditions

The successful candidate will ideally hold a RTPI accredited undergraduate or postgraduate degree.
Occasional weeknight working is required for this job (Planning Committees are held in the evening)

The recruitment process is anonymous and we don’t accept CVs.

Applicant handbook - please read the guidance in this handbook when applying. It is essential that you complete the application fully and that your supporting statement covers how you meet each of the person specification criteria listed.

Self-motivated, independent, and organized.

Understanding of technical cyber security compliance and certification activities such as NIST, PCI, and ISO27001.

As our Dutch speaking Customer Success Manager at Rentman, you’ll do more than answer questions or solve issues. You’re the strategic partner who helps our customers get the most value out of our platform and transform the way they run their business. You’ll work with rental companies and event professionals who rely on Rentman to manage fast-paced operations, guiding them through onboarding, adoption, and everyday use. Your mission: help them unlock the full potential of our platform so they can deliver flawless events, scale efficiently and stay ahead of the competition.
Your goal is to help customers succeed with Rentman, ensuring they can deliver events smoothly, scale efficiently and get the results they’re aiming for. You’ll also collaborate closely with Sales, Product and Support contributing to strategic conversations that influence both customer outcomes and the future of our platform.

What you'll do

Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with your customer portfolio through regular check-ins and proactive guidance.
Understand customer goals, usage patterns, and challenges through customer interactions and Vitally data, in order to drive customer health, product adoption and identify expansion and upsell opportunities.
Be the voice of your market by sharing recurring feedback with Product, influencing our roadmap and making sure our platform stays ahead of industry needs.
Lead impactful customer consultation sessions that empower users to make the most of Rentman, driving customer health, product adoption and advocacy.
Work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing and Support to ensure smooth handovers and an aligned customer experience.

What we are looking for

2+ years’ experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, or Implementation – ideally in a B2B or SaaS environment within the AV or Event Rental industry.
Fluent in Dutch and in English, with the ability to engage confidently with both customers and colleagues across diverse backgrounds.
Having a strategic mindset, being able to link product capabilities to business objectives and uncover opportunities for greater impact.
An excellent communicator who can break down complex topics into clear, actionable steps for users of all technical levels and at turning data into meaningful insights.
Structured and detail-oriented, able to manage your portfolio of customers and keep track of timelines, technical requirements and tasks.
Proactive and accountable, taking full ownership of your market and customer base while turning challenges into opportunities.
Collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional settings.
A personality that thrives at Rentman – strong ownership, collaborative spirit, curiosity and a drive to solve complex problems together.

Nice to haves

Cloud product know-how.

What you’ll get

A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)
25 vacation days to recharge

Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

An annual training budget to grow your skills
Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth
Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac
Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership
An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office
An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team
A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities
An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Introduction Call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30-45 mins)
